aboleth.special.1.name: Amphibious
aboleth.special.1.desc: The aboleth can breathe air and water.
aboleth.special.2.name: Eldritch Restoration
aboleth.special.2.desc: If destroyed, the aboleth gains a new body in 5d10 days, reviving with all its Hit Points in the Far Realm or another location chosen by the GM.
aboleth.special.3.name: Legendary Resistance
aboleth.special.3.desc: If the aboleth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
aboleth.special.4.name: Mucus Cloud
aboleth.special.4.desc: While underwater, the aboleth is surrounded by mucus. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the aboleth at the end of the aboleth’s turn. Failure: The target is cursed. Until the curse ends, the target’s skin becomes slimy, the target can breathe air and water, and it can’t regain Hit Points unless it is underwater. While the cursed creature is outside a body of water, the creature takes 6 (1d12) Acid damage at the end of every 10 minutes unless moisture is applied to its skin before those minutes have passed.
aboleth.special.5.name: Probing Telepathy
aboleth.special.5.desc: If a creature the aboleth can see communicates telepathically with the aboleth, the aboleth learns the creature’s greatest desires.
aboleth.actions.1.name: Multiattack
aboleth.actions.1.desc: The aboleth makes two Tentacle attacks and uses either Consume Memories or Dominate Mind if available.
aboleth.actions.2.name: Tentacle
aboleth.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 15 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of four tentacles.
aboleth.actions.3.name: Consume Memories
aboleth.actions.3.desc: Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature within 30 feet that is Charmed or Grappled by the aboleth. Failure: 10 (3d6) Psychic damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: The aboleth gains the target’s memories if the target is a Humanoid and is reduced to 0 Hit Points by this action.
aboleth.actions.4.name: Dominate Mind
aboleth.actions.4.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the aboleth can see within 30 feet. Failure: The target has the Charmed condition until the aboleth dies or is on a different plane of existence from the target. While Charmed, the target acts as an ally to the aboleth and is under its control while within 60 feet of it. In addition, the aboleth and the target can communicate telepathically with each other over any distance. The target repeats the save whenever it takes damage as well as after every 24 hours it spends at least 1 mile away from the aboleth, ending the effect on itself on a success.
aboleth.legendary.1.name: Lash
aboleth.legendary.1.desc: The aboleth makes one Tentacle attack.
aboleth.legendary.2.name: Psychic Drain
aboleth.legendary.2.desc: If the aboleth has at least one creature Charmed or Grappled, it uses Consume Memories and regains 5 (1d10) Hit Points.
aboleth.name: Aboleth
air-elemental.special.1.name: Air Form
air-elemental.special.1.desc: The elemental can enter a creature’s space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.
air-elemental.actions.1.name: Multiattack
air-elemental.actions.1.desc: The elemental makes two Thunderous Slam attacks.
air-elemental.actions.2.name: Thunderous Slam
air-elemental.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Thunder damage.
air-elemental.actions.3.name: Whirlwind
air-elemental.actions.3.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 13, one Medium or smaller creature in the elemental’s space. Failure: 24 (4d10 + 2) Thunder damage, and the target is pushed up to 20 feet straight away from the elemental and has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.
air-elemental.name: Air Elemental
animated-armor.actions.1.name: Multiattack
animated-armor.actions.1.desc: The armor makes two Slam attacks.
animated-armor.actions.2.name: Slam
animated-armor.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.
animated-armor.name: Animated Armor
animated-flying-sword.actions.1.name: Slash
animated-flying-sword.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Slashing damage.
animated-flying-sword.name: Animated Flying Sword
animated-rug-of-smothering.actions.1.des: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the rug can give it the Grappled condition (escape DC 13) instead of dealing damage. Until the grapple ends, the target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, is suffocating, and takes 10 (2d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns. The rug can smother only one creature at a time. While grappling the target, the rug can’t take this action, the rug halves the damage it takes (round down), and the target takes the same amount of damage.
animated-rug-of-smothering.name: Animated Rug of Smothering
ankheg.special.1.name: Tunneler
ankheg.special.1.desc: The ankheg can burrow through solid rock at half its Burrow Speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.
ankheg.actions.1.name: Bite
ankheg.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5 (with Advantage if the target is Grappled by the ankheg), reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13).
ankheg.actions.2.name: Acid Spray
ankheg.actions.2.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. Failure: 14 (4d6) Acid damage. Success: Half damage.
ankheg.name: Ankheg
assassin.special.1.name: Evasion
assassin.special.1.desc: If the assassin is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the assassin instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the save and only half damage if it fails. It can’t use this trait if it has the Incapacitated condition.
assassin.actions.1.name: Multiattack
assassin.actions.1.desc: The assassin makes three attacks, using Shortsword or Light Crossbow in any combination.
assassin.actions.2.name: Shortsword
assassin.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 17 (5d6) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the assassin’s next turn.
assassin.actions.3.name: Light Crossbow
assassin.actions.3.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 21 (6d6) Poison damage.
assassin.bonusActions.1.name: Cunning Action
assassin.bonusActions.1.desc: The assassin takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.
assassin.name: Assassin
awakened-shrub.actions.1.name: Rake
awakened-shrub.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +1, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Slashing damage.
awakened-shrub.name: Awakened Shrub
awakened-tree.actions.1.name: Slam
awakened-tree.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.
awakened-tree.name: Awakened Tree
axe-beak.actions.1.name: Beak
axe-beak.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Slashing damage.
axe-beak.name: Axe Beak
azer-sentinel.special.1.name: Fire Aura
azer-sentinel.special.1.desc: At the end of each of the azer’s turns, each creature of the azer’s choice in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the azer takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage unless the azer has the Incapacitated condition.
azer-sentinel.special.2.name: Illumination
azer-sentinel.special.2.desc: The azer sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.
azer-sentinel.actions.1.name: Burning Hammer
azer-sentinel.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.
azer-sentinel.name: Azer Sentinel
balor.special.1.name: Death Throes
balor.special.1.desc: The balor explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 20, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the balor. Failure: 31 (9d6) Fire damage plus 31 (9d6) Force damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: If the balor dies outside the Abyss, it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.
balor.special.2.name: Fire Aura
balor.special.2.desc: At the end of each of the balor’s turns, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the balor takes 13 (3d8) Fire damage.
balor.special.3.name: Legendary Resistance
balor.special.3.desc: If the balor fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
balor.special.4.name: Magic Resistance
balor.special.4.desc: The balor has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
balor.actions.1.name: Multiattack
balor.actions.1.desc: The balor makes one Flame Whip attack and one Lightning Blade attack.
balor.actions.2.name: Flame Whip
balor.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 30 ft. Hit: 18 (3d6 + 8) Force damage plus 17 (5d6) Fire damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, the balor pulls the target up to 25 feet straight toward itself, and the target has the Prone condition.
balor.actions.3.name: Lightning Blade
balor.actions.3.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) Force damage plus 22 (4d10) Lightning damage, and the target can’t take Reactions until the start of the balor’s next turn.
balor.bonusActions.1.name: Teleport
balor.bonusActions.1.desc: The balor teleports itself or a willing demon within 10 feet of itself up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space the balor can see.
balor.name: Balor
bandit.actions.1.name: Scimitar
bandit.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Slashing damage.
bandit.actions.2.name: Light Crossbow
bandit.actions.2.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +3, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage.
bandit.name: Bandit
bandit-captain.actions.1.name: Multiattack
bandit-captain.actions.1.desc: The bandit makes two attacks, using Scimitar and Pistol in any combination.
bandit-captain.actions.2.name: Scimitar
bandit-captain.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage.
bandit-captain.actions.3.name: Pistol
bandit-captain.actions.3.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 30/90 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage.
bandit-captain.reactions.1.name: Parry
bandit-captain.reactions.1.desc: Trigger: The bandit is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The bandit adds 2 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.
bandit-captain.name: Bandit Captain
barbed-devil.special.1.name: Barbed Hide
barbed-devil.special.1.desc: At the start of each of its turns, the devil deals 5 (1d10) Piercing damage to any creature it is grappling or any creature grappling it.
barbed-devil.special.2.name: Diabolical Restoration
barbed-devil.special.2.desc: If the devil dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.
barbed-devil.special.3.name: Magic Resistance
barbed-devil.special.3.desc: The devil has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
barbed-devil.actions.1.name: Multiattack
barbed-devil.actions.1.desc: The devil makes one Claws attack and one Tail attack, or it makes two Hurl Flame attacks.
barbed-devil.actions.2.name: Claws
barbed-devil.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13) from both claws.
barbed-devil.actions.3.name: Tail
barbed-devil.actions.3.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) Slashing damage.
barbed-devil.actions.4.name: Hurl Flame
barbed-devil.actions.4.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 150 ft. Hit: 17 (5d6) Fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn’t being worn or carried, it starts burning.
barbed-devil.name: Barbed Devil
basilisk.actions.1.name: Bite
basilisk.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.
basilisk.bonusActions.1.name: Petrifying Gaze
basilisk.bonusActions.1.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. If the basilisk sees its reflection in the Cone, the basilisk must make this save. First Failure: The target has the Restrained condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. Second Failure: The target has the Petrified condition instead of the Restrained condition.
basilisk.name: Basilisk
bearded-devil.special.1.name: Magic Resistance
bearded-devil.special.1.desc: The devil has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
bearded-devil.actions.1.name: Multiattack
bearded-devil.actions.1.desc: The devil makes one Beard attack and one Infernal Glaive attack.
bearded-devil.actions.2.name: Beard
bearded-devil.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the devil’s next turn. Until this poison ends, the target can’t regain Hit Points.
bearded-devil.actions.3.name: Infernal Glaive
bearded-devil.actions.3.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 10 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage. If the target is a creature and doesn’t already have an infernal wound, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The target receives an infernal wound. While wounded, the target loses 5 (1d10) Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. The wound closes after 1 minute, after a spell restores Hit Points to the target, or after the target or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to stanch the wound, doing so by succeeding on a DC 12 Wisdom (Medicine) check.
bearded-devil.name: Bearded Devil
behir.actions.1.name: Multiattack
behir.actions.1.desc: The behir makes one Bite attack and uses Constrict.
behir.actions.2.name: Bite
behir.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) Piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) Lightning damage.
behir.actions.3.name: Constrict
behir.actions.3.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 18, one Large or smaller creature the behir can see within 5 feet. Failure: 28 (5d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.
behir.actions.4.name: Lightning Breath
behir.actions.4.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature in a 90-foot-long, 5-footwide Line. Failure: 66 (12d10) Lightning damage. Success: Half damage.
behir.bonusActions.1.name: Swallow
behir.bonusActions.1.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18, one Large or smaller creature Grappled by the behir (the behir can have only one creature swallowed at a time). Failure: The behir swallows the target, which is no longer Grappled. While swallowed, a creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the behir, and takes 21 (6d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the behir’s turns. If the behir takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the behir must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls in a space within 10 feet of the behir and has the Prone condition. If the behir dies, a swallowed creature is no longer Restrained and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting Prone.
behir.name: Behir
berserker.special.1.name: Bloodied Frenzy
berserker.special.1.desc: While Bloodied, the berserker has Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws.
berserker.actions.1.name: Greataxe
berserker.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) Slashing damage.
berserker.name: Berserker
black-dragon-wyrmling.special.1.name: Amphibious
black-dragon-wyrmling.special.1.desc: The dragon can breathe air and water.
black-dragon-wyrmling.actions.1.name: Multiattack
black-dragon-wyrmling.actions.1.desc: The dragon makes two Rend attacks.
black-dragon-wyrmling.actions.2.name: Rend
black-dragon-wyrmling.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Acid damage.
black-dragon-wyrmling.actions.3.name: Acid Breath
black-dragon-wyrmling.actions.3.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 15-foot-long, 5-footwide Line. Failure: 22 (5d8) Acid damage. Success: Half damage.
black-dragon-wyrmling.name: Black Dragon Wyrmling

young-black-dragon.special.1.desc: The dragon can breathe air and water.
young-black-dragon.actions.1.name: Multiattack
young-black-dragon.actions.1.desc: The dragon makes three Rend attacks.
young-black-dragon.actions.2.name: Rend
young-black-dragon.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Acid damage.
young-black-dragon.actions.3.name: Acid Breath
young-black-dragon.actions.3.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 30-foot-long, 5-footwide Line. Failure: 49 (14d6) Acid damage. Success: Half damage.
young-black-dragon.name: Young Black Dragon

adult-black-dragon.special.1.desc: The dragon can breathe air and water.
adult-black-dragon.special.2.name: Legendary Resistance
adult-black-dragon.special.2.desc: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
adult-black-dragon.actions.1.name: Multiattack
adult-black-dragon.actions.1.desc: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast Acid Arrow (level 3 version).
adult-black-dragon.actions.2.name: Rend
adult-black-dragon.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Acid damage.
adult-black-dragon.actions.3.name: Acid Breath
adult-black-dragon.actions.3.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature in a 60-foot-long, 5-footwide Line. Failure: 54 (12d8) Acid damage. Success: Half damage.
adult-black-dragon.actions.4.name: Spellcasting
adult-black-dragon.actions.4.desc: The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks):
adult-black-dragon.legendary.1.name: Cloud of Insects
adult-black-dragon.legendary.1.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature the dragon can see within 120 feet. Failure: 22 (4d10) Poison damage, and the target has Disadvantage on saving throws to maintain Concentration until the end of its next turn. Failure or Success: The dragon can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.
adult-black-dragon.legendary.2.name: Frightful Presence
adult-black-dragon.legendary.2.desc: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast Fear. The dragon can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.
adult-black-dragon.legendary.3.name: Pounce
adult-black-dragon.legendary.3.desc: The dragon moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Rend attack.
adult-black-dragon.name: Adult Black Dragon

ancient-black-dragon.special.1.desc: The dragon can breathe air and water.

ancient-black-dragon.actions.1.name: Multiattack
ancient-black-dragon.actions.1.desc: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast Acid Arrow (level 4 version).
ancient-black-dragon.actions.2.name: Rend
ancient-black-dragon.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +15, reach 15 ft. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Acid damage.

ancient-black-dragon.actions.3.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 22, each creature in a 90-foot-long, 10-footwide Line. Failure: 67 (15d8) Acid damage. Success: Half damage.
ancient-black-dragon.actions.4.name: Spellcasting
ancient-black-dragon.actions.4.desc: The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 21, +13 to hit with spell attacks):

Failure or Success: The dragon can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.
ancient-black-dragon.legendary.2.name: Frightful Presence
ancient-black-dragon.legendary.2.desc: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast Fear. The dragon can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.
ancient-black-dragon.legendary.3.name: Pounce
ancient-black-dragon.legendary.3.desc: The dragon moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Rend attack.
ancient-black-dragon.name: Ancient Black Dragon
black-pudding.special.1.name: Amorphous
black-pudding.special.1.desc: The pudding can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.
black-pudding.special.2.name: Corrosive Form
black-pudding.special.2.desc: A creature that hits the pudding with a melee attack roll takes 4 (1d8) Acid damage. Nonmagical ammunition is destroyed immediately after hitting the pudding and dealing any damage. Any nonmagical weapon takes a cumulative −1 penalty to attack rolls immediately after dealing damage to the pudding and coming into contact with it. The weapon is destroyed if the penalty reaches −5. The penalty can be removed by casting the Mending spell on the weapon. In 1 minute, the pudding can eat through 2 feet of nonmagical wood or metal.
black-pudding.special.3.name: Spider Climb
black-pudding.special.3.desc: The pudding can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
black-pudding.actions.1.name: Dissolving Pseudopod
black-pudding.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 10 ft. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) Acid damage. Nonmagical armor worn by the target takes a −1 penalty to the AC it offers. The armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10. The penalty can be removed by casting the Mending spell on the armor.
black-pudding.reactions.1.name: Split
black-pudding.reactions.1.desc: Trigger: While the pudding is Large or Medium and has 10+ Hit Points, it becomes Bloodied or is subjected to Lightning or Slashing damage. Response: The pudding splits into two new Black Puddings. Each new pudding is one size smaller than the original pudding and acts on its Initiative. The original pudding’s Hit Points are divided evenly between the new puddings (round down).
black-pudding.name: Black Pudding
blink-dog.actions.1.name: Bite
blink-dog.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage.
blink-dog.bonusActions.1.name: Teleport
blink-dog.bonusActions.1.desc: The dog teleports up to 40 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.
blink-dog.name: Blink Dog
blink-dog.languages: Blink Dog; understands Elvish and Sylvan but can’t speak them

blue-dragon-wyrmling.actions.1.desc: The dragon makes two Rend attacks.
blue-dragon-wyrmling.actions.2.name: Rend
blue-dragon-wyrmling.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Lightning damage.
blue-dragon-wyrmling.actions.3.name: Lightning Breath
blue-dragon-wyrmling.actions.3.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 30-foot-long, 5-footwide Line. Failure: 21 (6d6) Lightning damage. Success: Half damage.
blue-dragon-wyrmling.name: Blue Dragon Wyrmling

young-blue-dragon.actions.2.name: Rend
young-blue-dragon.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 5 (1d10) Lightning damage.
young-blue-dragon.actions.3.name: Lightning Breath
young-blue-dragon.actions.3.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature in a 60-foot-long, 5-footwide Line. Failure: 55 (10d10) Lightning damage. Success: Half damage.
young-blue-dragon.name: Young Blue Dragon
adult-blue-dragon.special.1.name: Legendary Resistance
adult-blue-dragon.special.1.desc: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
adult-blue-dragon.actions.1.name: Multiattack
adult-blue-dragon.actions.1.desc: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast Shatter.
adult-blue-dragon.actions.2.name: Rend
adult-blue-dragon.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) Slashing damage plus 5 (1d10) Lightning damage.
adult-blue-dragon.actions.3.name: Lightning Breath
adult-blue-dragon.actions.3.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 19, each creature in a 90-foot-long, 5-footwide Line. Failure: 60 (11d10) Lightning damage. Success: Half damage.

If the target is a Medium or smaller creature and the darkmantle had Advantage on the attack roll, it covers the target, which has the Blinded condition and is suffocating while the darkmantle is attached in this way. While attached to a target, the darkmantle can attack only the target but has Advantage on its attack rolls. Its Speed becomes 0, it can’t benefit from any bonus to its Speed, and it moves with the target. A creature can take an action to try to detach the darkmantle from itself, doing so with a successful DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check. On its turn, the darkmantle can detach itself by using 5 feet of movement.

darkmantle.actions.2.desc: Magical Darkness fills a 15-foot Emanation originating from the darkmantle. This effect lasts while the darkmantle maintains Concentration on it, up to 10 minutes. Darkvision can’t penetrate this area, and no light can illuminate it.

First Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition. While Poisoned, the target’s Hit Point maximum doesn’t return to normal when finishing a Long Rest, and it repeats the save every 24 hours that elapse, ending the effect on itself on a success. Subsequent Failures: The Poisoned target’s Hit Point maximum decreases by 5 (1d10).

djinni.special.2.desc: The djinni has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

djinni.special.3.desc: The djinni has a 30 percent chance of knowing the Wish spell. If the djinni knows it, the djinni can cast it only on behalf of a non-genie creature who communicates a wish in a way the djinni can understand. If the djinni casts the spell for the creature, the djinni suffers none of the spell’s stress. Once the djinni has cast it three times, the djinni can’t do so again for 365 days.

The whirlwind lasts until the djinni’s Concentration on it ends. The djinni can move the whirlwind up to 20 feet at the start of each of its turns. Whenever the whirlwind enters a creature’s space or a creature enters the whirlwind, that creature is subjected to the following effect. Strength Saving Throw: DC 17 (a creature makes this save only once per turn, and the djinni is unaffected). Failure: While in the whirlwind, the target has the Restrained condition and moves with the whirlwind. At the start of each of its turns, the Restrained target takes 21 (6d6) Thunder damage. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

erinyes.special.1.desc: If the erinyes dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.
erinyes.special.2.name: Magic Resistance
erinyes.special.2.desc: The erinyes has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
erinyes.special.3.name: Magic Rope
erinyes.special.3.desc: The erinyes has a magic rope. While bearing it, the erinyes can use the Entangling Rope action. The rope has AC 20, HP 90, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. The rope turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points, if it is 5+ feet away from the erinyes for 1 hour or more, or if the erinyes dies. If the rope is damaged or destroyed, the erinyes can fully restore it when finishing a Short or Long Rest.
erinyes.actions.1.name: Multiattack
erinyes.actions.1.desc: The erinyes makes three Withering Sword attacks and can use Entangling Rope.
erinyes.actions.2.name: Withering Sword
erinyes.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage.
erinyes.actions.3.name: Entangling Rope (Requires Magic Rope)
erinyes.actions.3.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the erinyes can see within 120 feet. Failure: 14 (4d6) Force damage, and the target has the Restrained condition until the rope is destroyed, the erinyes uses a Bonus Action to release the target, or the erinyes uses Entangling Rope again.
erinyes.reactions.1.name: Parry
erinyes.reactions.1.desc: Trigger: The erinyes is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The erinyes adds 4 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.
erinyes.name: Erinyes
ettercap.special.1.name: Spider Climb
ettercap.special.1.desc: The ettercap can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
ettercap.special.2.name: Web Walker
ettercap.special.2.desc: The ettercap ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the ettercap knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.
ettercap.actions.1.name: Multiattack
ettercap.actions.1.desc: The ettercap makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.
ettercap.actions.2.name: Bite
ettercap.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the ettercap’s next turn.
ettercap.actions.3.name: Claw
ettercap.actions.3.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Slashing damage.
ettercap.actions.4.name: Web Strand
ettercap.actions.4.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12, one Large or smaller creature the ettercap can see within 30 feet. Failure: The target has the Restrained condition until the web is destroyed (AC 10; HP 5; Vulnerability to Fire damage; Immunity to Bludgeoning, Poison, and Psychic damage).
ettercap.bonusActions.1.name: Reel
ettercap.bonusActions.1.desc: The ettercap pulls one creature within 30 feet of itself that is Restrained by its Web Strand up to 25 feet straight toward itself.
ettercap.name: Ettercap
ettin.actions.1.name: Multiattack
ettin.actions.1.desc: The ettin makes one Battleaxe attack and one Morningstar attack.
ettin.actions.2.name: Battleaxe
ettin.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.
ettin.actions.3.name: Morningstar
ettin.actions.3.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage, and the target has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.
ettin.name: Ettin
fire-elemental.special.1.name: Fire Aura
fire-elemental.special.1.desc: At the end of each of the elemental’s turns, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the elemental takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage. Creatures and flammable objects in the Emanation start burning.
fire-elemental.special.2.name: Fire Form
fire-elemental.special.2.desc: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so, and it can enter a creature’s space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature’s space on a turn, that creature takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage.
fire-elemental.special.3.name: Illumination
fire-elemental.special.3.desc: The elemental sheds Bright Light in a 30foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet.
fire-elemental.special.4.name: Water Susceptibility
fire-elemental.special.4.desc: The elemental takes 3 (1d6) Cold damage for every 5 feet the elemental moves in water or for every gallon of water splashed on it.
fire-elemental.actions.1.name: Multiattack
fire-elemental.actions.1.desc: The elemental makes two Burn attacks.
fire-elemental.actions.2.name: Burn
fire-elemental.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it starts burning.
fire-elemental.name: Fire Elemental
fire-giant.actions.1.name: Multiattack
fire-giant.actions.1.desc: The giant makes two attacks, using Flame Sword or Hammer Throw in any combination.
fire-giant.actions.2.name: Flame Sword
fire-giant.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 10 ft. Hit: 21 (4d6 + 7) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.
fire-giant.actions.3.name: Hammer Throw
fire-giant.actions.3.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +11, range 60/240 ft. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) Fire damage, and the target is pushed up to 15 feet straight away from the giant and has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.
fire-giant.name: Fire Giant
flesh-golem.special.1.name: Aversion to Fire
flesh-golem.special.1.desc: If the golem takes Fire damage, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.
flesh-golem.special.2.name: Berserk
flesh-golem.special.2.desc: Whenever the golem starts its turn Bloodied, roll 1d6. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object. Once the golem goes berserk, it remains so until it is destroyed or it is no longer Bloodied. The golem’s creator, if within 60 feet of the berserk golem, can try to calm it by taking an action to make a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check; the golem must be able to hear its creator. If this check succeeds, the golem ceases being berserk until the start of its next turn, at which point it resumes rolling for the Berserk trait again if it is still Bloodied.
flesh-golem.special.3.name: Immutable Form
flesh-golem.special.4.name: Lightning Absorption
flesh-golem.special.4.desc: Whenever the golem is subjected to Lightning damage, it regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Lightning damage dealt.
flesh-golem.special.5.name: Magic Resistance
flesh-golem.special.5.desc: The golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
flesh-golem.actions.1.name: Multiattack
flesh-golem.actions.1.desc: The golem makes two Slam attacks.
flesh-golem.actions.2.name: Slam
flesh-golem.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) Lightning damage.
flesh-golem.name: Flesh Golem
flesh-golem.languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can’t speak
frost-giant.actions.1.name: Multiattack
frost-giant.actions.1.desc: The giant makes two attacks, using Frost Axe or Great Bow in any combination.
frost-giant.actions.2.name: Frost Axe
frost-giant.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Cold damage.
frost-giant.actions.3.name: Great Bow
frost-giant.actions.3.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Cold damage, and the target’s Speed decreases by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.
frost-giant.bonusActions.1.name: War Cry
frost-giant.bonusActions.1.desc: The giant or one creature of its choice that can see or hear it gains 16 (2d10 + 5) Temporary Hit Points and has Advantage on attack rolls until the start of the giant’s next turn.
frost-giant.name: Frost Giant
shrieker-fungus.reactions.1.name: Shriek
shrieker-fungus.reactions.1.desc: Trigger: A creature or a source of Bright Light moves within 30 feet of the shrieker. Response: The shrieker emits a shriek audible within 300 feet of itself for 1 minute or until the shrieker dies.
shrieker-fungus.name: Shrieker Fungus
violet-fungus.actions.1.name: Multiattack
violet-fungus.actions.1.desc: The fungus makes two Rotting Touch attacks.
violet-fungus.actions.2.name: Rotting Touch
violet-fungus.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 10 ft. Hit: 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage.
violet-fungus.name: Violet Fungus
gargoyle.special.1.name: Flyby
gargoyle.special.1.desc: The gargoyle doesn’t provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy’s reach.
gargoyle.actions.1.name: Multiattack
gargoyle.actions.1.desc: The gargoyle makes two Claw attacks.
gargoyle.actions.2.name: Claw
gargoyle.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Slashing damage.
gargoyle.name: Gargoyle
gelatinous-cube.special.1.name: Ooze Cube
gelatinous-cube.special.1.desc: The cube fills its entire space and is transparent. Other creatures can enter that space, but a creature that does so is subjected to the cube’s Engulf and has Disadvantage on the saving throw. Creatures inside the cube have Total Cover, and the cube can hold one Large creature or up to four Medium or Small creatures inside itself at a time. As an action, a creature within 5 feet of the cube can pull a creature or an object out of the cube by succeeding on a DC 12 Strength (Athletics) check, and the puller takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage.
gelatinous-cube.special.2.name: Transparent
gelatinous-cube.special.2.desc: Even when the cube is in plain sight, a creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to notice the cube if the creature hasn’t witnessed the cube move or otherwise act.
gelatinous-cube.actions.1.name: Pseudopod
gelatinous-cube.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) Acid damage.
gelatinous-cube.actions.2.name: Engulf
gelatinous-cube.actions.2.desc: The cube moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. The cube can move through the spaces of Large or smaller creatures if it has room inside itself to contain them (see the Ooze Cube trait). Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature whose space the cube enters for the first time during this move. Failure: 10 (3d6) Acid damage, and the target is engulfed. An engulfed target is suffocating, can’t cast spells with a Verbal component, has the Restrained condition, and takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the cube’s turns. When the cube moves, the engulfed target moves with it. An engulfed target can try to escape by taking an action to make a DC 12 Strength (Athletics) check. On a successful check, the target escapes and enters the nearest unoccupied space. Success: Half damage, and the target moves to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the cube. If there is no unoccupied space, the target fails the save instead.
gelatinous-cube.name: Gelatinous Cube
ghast.special.1.name: Stench
ghast.special.1.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, any creature that starts its turn in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the ghast. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition until the start of its next turn. Success: The target is immune to this ghast’s Stench for 24 hours.
ghast.actions.1.name: Bite
ghast.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage.
ghast.actions.2.name: Claw
ghast.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage. If the target is a non-Undead creature, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10. Failure: The target has the Paralyzed condition until the end of its next turn.
ghast.name: Ghast
ghost.special.1.name: Ethereal Sight
ghost.special.1.desc: The ghost can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane.
ghost.special.2.name: Incorporeal Movement
ghost.special.2.desc: The ghost can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
ghost.actions.1.name: Multiattack
ghost.actions.1.desc: The ghost makes two Withering Touch attacks.
ghost.actions.2.name: Withering Touch
ghost.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 19 (3d10 + 3) Necrotic damage.
ghost.actions.3.name: Etherealness
ghost.actions.3.desc: The ghost casts the Etherealness spell, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability. The ghost is visible on the Material Plane while on the Border Ethereal and vice versa, but it can’t affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.
ghost.actions.4.name: Horrific Visage
ghost.actions.4.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 60-foot Cone that can see the ghost and isn’t an Undead. Failure: 10 (2d6 + 3) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the ghost’s next turn. Success: The target is immune to this ghost’s Horrific Visage for 24 hours.
ghost.actions.5.name: Possession
ghost.actions.5.desc: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 13, one Humanoid the ghost can see within 5 feet. Failure: The target is possessed by the ghost; the ghost disappears, and the target has the Incapacitated condition and loses control of its body. The ghost now controls the body, but the target retains awareness. The ghost can’t be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that specifically target Undead. The ghost’s game statistics are the same, except it uses the possessed target’s Speed, as well as the target’s Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution modifiers. The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 Hit Points or the ghost leaves as a Bonus Action. When the possession ends, the ghost appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target, and the target is immune to this ghost’s Possession for 24 hours. Success: The target is immune to this ghost’s Possession for 24 hours.
ghost.name: Ghost
ghost.resistances: acid; bludgeoning; cold; fire; lightning; piercing; slashing; thunder
ghoul.actions.1.name: Multiattack
ghoul.actions.1.desc: The ghoul makes two Bite attacks.
ghoul.actions.2.name: Bite
ghoul.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Necrotic damage.
ghoul.actions.3.name: Claw
ghoul.actions.3.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Slashing damage. If the target is a creature that isn’t an Undead or elf, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10. Failure: The target has the Paralyzed condition until the end of its next turn.
ghoul.name: Ghoul
gibbering-mouther.special.1.name: Aberrant Ground
gibbering-mouther.special.1.desc: The ground in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the mouther is Difficult Terrain.
gibbering-mouther.special.2.name: Gibbering
gibbering-mouther.special.2.desc: The mouther babbles incoherently while it doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 10, any creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the mouther while it is babbling. Failure: The target rolls 1d8 to determine what it does during the current turn: 1–4. The target does nothing. 5–6. The target takes no action or Bonus Action and uses all its movement to move in a random direction. 7–8. The target makes a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach or does nothing if it can’t make such an attack.
gibbering-mouther.actions.1.name: Bite
gibbering-mouther.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition. The target dies if it is reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack. Its body is then absorbed into the mouther, leaving only equipment behind.
gibbering-mouther.actions.2.name: Blinding Spittle
gibbering-mouther.actions.2.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within 30 feet. Failure: 7 (2d6) Radiant damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the end of the mouther’s next turn.
gibbering-mouther.name: Gibbering Mouther
glabrezu.special.1.name: Demonic Restoration
glabrezu.special.1.desc: If the glabrezu dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.
glabrezu.special.2.name: Magic Resistance
glabrezu.special.2.desc: The glabrezu has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
glabrezu.actions.1.name: Multiattack
glabrezu.actions.1.desc: The glabrezu makes two Pincer attacks and uses Pummel or Spellcasting.
glabrezu.actions.2.name: Pincer
glabrezu.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15) from one of two pincers.
glabrezu.actions.3.name: Pummel
glabrezu.actions.3.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature Grappled by the glabrezu. Failure: 15 (3d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. Success: Half damage.
glabrezu.actions.4.name: Spellcasting
glabrezu.actions.4.desc: The glabrezu casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):
glabrezu.name: Glabrezu
gladiator.actions.1.name: Multiattack
gladiator.actions.1.desc: The gladiator makes three Spear attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Shield Bash.
gladiator.actions.2.name: Spear
gladiator.actions.2.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage.
gladiator.actions.3.name: Shield Bash
gladiator.actions.3.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature within 5 feet that the gladiator can see. Failure: 9 (2d4 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.
gladiator.reactions.1.name: Parry
gladiator.reactions.1.desc: Trigger: The gladiator is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The gladiator adds 3 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.
gladiator.name: Gladiator
gnoll-warrior.actions.1.name: Rend
gnoll-warrior.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.
gnoll-warrior.actions.2.name: Bone Bow
gnoll-warrior.actions.2.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +3, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 6 (1d10 + 1) Piercing damage.
gnoll-warrior.bonusActions.1.name: Rampage
gnoll-warrior.bonusActions.1.desc: Immediately after dealing damage to a creature that is already Bloodied, the gnoll moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Rend attack.
gnoll-warrior.name: Gnoll Warrior
goblin-minion.actions.1.name: Dagger
goblin-minion.actions.1.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage.
goblin-minion.bonusActions.1.name: Nimble Escape
goblin-minion.bonusActions.1.desc: The goblin takes the Disengage or Hide action.
goblin-minion.name: Goblin Minion
goblin-warrior.actions.1.name: Scimitar
goblin-warrior.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage, plus 2 (1d4) Slashing damage if the attack roll had Advantage.
goblin-warrior.actions.2.name: Shortbow
goblin-warrior.actions.2.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage, plus 2 (1d4) Piercing damage if the attack roll had Advantage.
goblin-warrior.bonusActions.1.name: Nimble Escape
goblin-warrior.bonusActions.1.desc: The goblin takes the Disengage or Hide action.
goblin-warrior.name: Goblin Warrior
goblin-boss.actions.1.name: Multiattack
goblin-boss.actions.1.desc: The goblin makes two attacks, using Scimitar or Shortbow in any combination.
goblin-boss.actions.2.name: Scimitar
goblin-boss.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage, plus 2 (1d4) Slashing damage if the attack roll had Advantage.
goblin-boss.actions.3.name: Shortbow
goblin-boss.actions.3.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage, plus 2 (1d4) Piercing damage if the attack roll had Advantage.
goblin-boss.bonusActions.1.name: Nimble Escape
goblin-boss.bonusActions.1.desc: The goblin takes the Disengage or Hide action.
goblin-boss.reactions.1.name: Redirect Attack
goblin-boss.reactions.1.desc: Trigger: A creature the goblin can see makes an attack roll against it. Response: The goblin chooses a Small or Medium ally within 5 feet of itself. The goblin and that ally swap places, and the ally becomes the target of the attack instead.
goblin-boss.name: Goblin Boss
gold-dragon-wyrmling.special.1.name: Amphibious
gold-dragon-wyrmling.special.1.desc: The dragon can breathe air and water.
gold-dragon-wyrmling.actions.1.name: Multiattack
gold-dragon-wyrmling.actions.1.desc: The dragon makes two Rend attacks.
gold-dragon-wyrmling.actions.2.name: Rend
gold-dragon-wyrmling.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing damage.
gold-dragon-wyrmling.actions.3.name: Fire Breath
gold-dragon-wyrmling.actions.3.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 22 (4d10) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.
gold-dragon-wyrmling.actions.4.name: Weakening Breath
gold-dragon-wyrmling.actions.4.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature that isn’t currently affected by this breath in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: The target has Disadvantage on Strength-based D20 Tests and subtracts 2 (1d4) from its damage rolls. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.
gold-dragon-wyrmling.name: Gold Dragon Wyrmling
young-gold-dragon.special.1.name: Amphibious
young-gold-dragon.special.1.desc: The dragon can breathe air and water.
young-gold-dragon.actions.1.name: Multiattack
young-gold-dragon.actions.1.desc: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Weakening Breath.
young-gold-dragon.actions.2.name: Rend
young-gold-dragon.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) Slashing damage.
young-gold-dragon.actions.3.name: Fire Breath
young-gold-dragon.actions.3.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 55 (10d10) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.
young-gold-dragon.actions.4.name: Weakening Breath
young-gold-dragon.actions.4.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature that isn’t currently affected by this breath in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: The target has Disadvantage on Strength-based D20 Tests and subtracts 3 (1d6) from its damage rolls. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.
young-gold-dragon.name: Young Gold Dragon
adult-gold-dragon.special.1.name: Amphibious
adult-gold-dragon.special.1.desc: The dragon can breathe air and water.
adult-gold-dragon.special.2.name: Legendary Resistance
adult-gold-dragon.special.2.desc: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
adult-gold-dragon.actions.1.name: Multiattack
adult-gold-dragon.actions.1.desc: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of (A) Spellcasting to cast Guiding Bolt (level 2 version) or (B) Weakening Breath.
adult-gold-dragon.actions.2.name: Rend
adult-gold-dragon.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Fire damage.
adult-gold-dragon.actions.3.name: Fire Breath
adult-gold-dragon.actions.3.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 21, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. Failure: 66 (12d10) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.
adult-gold-dragon.actions.4.name: Spellcasting
adult-gold-dragon.actions.4.desc: The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 21, +13 to hit with spell attacks):
adult-gold-dragon.actions.5.name: Weakening Breath
adult-gold-dragon.actions.5.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 21, each creature that isn’t currently affected by this breath in a 60-foot Cone. Failure: The target has Disadvantage on Strength-based D20 Tests and subtracts 3 (1d6) from its damage rolls. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.
adult-gold-dragon.legendary.1.name: Banish
adult-gold-dragon.legendary.1.desc: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 21, one creature the dragon can see within 120 feet. Failure: 10 (3d6) Force damage, and the target has the Incapacitated condition and is transported to a harmless demiplane until the start of the dragon’s next turn, at which point it reappears in an unoccupied space of the dragon’s choice within 120 feet of the dragon. Failure or Success: The dragon can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.
adult-gold-dragon.legendary.2.name: Guiding Light
adult-gold-dragon.legendary.2.desc: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast Guiding Bolt (level 2 version).

ancient-gold-dragon.actions.1.desc: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of (A) Spellcasting to cast Guiding Bolt (level 4 version) or (B) Weakening Breath.
ancient-gold-dragon.actions.2.name: Rend
ancient-gold-dragon.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +17 to hit, reach 15 ft. Hit: 19 (2d8 + 10) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Fire damage.
ancient-gold-dragon.actions.3.name: Fire Breath
ancient-gold-dragon.actions.3.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 24, each creature in a 90-foot Cone. Failure: 71 (13d10) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.
ancient-gold-dragon.actions.4.name: Spellcasting
ancient-gold-dragon.actions.4.desc: The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 24, +16 to hit with spell attacks):
ancient-gold-dragon.actions.5.name: Weakening Breath
ancient-gold-dragon.actions.5.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 24, each creature that isn’t currently affected by this breath in a 90-foot Cone. Failure: The target has Disadvantage on Strength-based D20 Tests and subtracts 5 (1d10) from its damage rolls. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.
ancient-gold-dragon.legendary.1.name: Banish
ancient-gold-dragon.legendary.1.desc: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 24, one creature the dragon can see within 120 feet. Failure: 24 (7d6) Force damage, and the target has the Incapacitated condition and is transported to a harmless demiplane until the start of the dragon’s next turn, at which point it reappears in an unoccupied space of the dragon’s choice within 120 feet of the dragon. Failure or Success: The dragon can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.
ancient-gold-dragon.legendary.2.name: Guiding Light
ancient-gold-dragon.legendary.2.desc: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast Guiding Bolt (level 4 version).
ancient-gold-dragon.legendary.3.name: Pounce
ancient-gold-dragon.legendary.3.desc: The dragon moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Rend attack.
ancient-gold-dragon.name: Ancient Gold Dragon
gorgon.actions.1.name: Gore
gorgon.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the gorgon moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target has the Prone condition.
gorgon.actions.2.name: Petrifying Breath
gorgon.actions.2.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. First Failure: The target has the Restrained condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. Second Failure: The target has the Petrified condition instead of the Restrained condition.
gorgon.bonusActions.1.name: Trample
gorgon.bonusActions.1.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature within 5 feet that has the Prone condition. Failure: 16 (2d10 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. Success: Half damage.
gorgon.name: Gorgon
gray-ooze.special.1.name: Amorphous
gray-ooze.special.1.desc: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.
gray-ooze.special.2.name: Corrosive Form
gray-ooze.special.2.desc: Nonmagical ammunition is destroyed immediately after hitting the ooze and dealing any damage. Any nonmagical weapon takes a cumulative −1 penalty to attack rolls immediately after dealing damage to the ooze and coming into contact with it. The weapon is destroyed if the penalty reaches −5. The penalty can be removed by casting the Mending spell on the weapon. The ooze can eat through 2-inch-thick, nonmagical metal or wood in 1 round.
gray-ooze.actions.1.name: Pseudopod
gray-ooze.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d8 + 1) Acid damage. Nonmagical armor worn by the target takes a −1 penalty to the AC it offers. The armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10. The penalty can be removed by casting the Mending spell on the armor.
gray-ooze.name: Gray Ooze

green-hag.special.1.desc: The hag can breathe air and water.
green-hag.special.2.name: Coven Magic
green-hag.special.2.desc: While within 30 feet of at least two hag allies, the hag can cast one of the following spells, requiring no Material components, using the spell’s normal casting time, and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 11): Augury, Find Familiar, Identify, Locate Object, Scrying, or Unseen Servant. The hag must finish a Long Rest before using this trait to cast that spell again.
green-hag.special.3.name: Mimicry
green-hag.special.3.desc: The hag can mimic animal sounds and humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations only with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.
green-hag.actions.1.name: Multiattack
green-hag.actions.1.desc: The hag makes two Claw attacks.

green-hag.actions.3.name: Spellcasting
green-hag.actions.3.desc: The hag casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks):

grick.actions.1.desc: The grick makes one Beak attack and one Tentacles attack.
grick.actions.2.name: Beak
grick.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Piercing damage.
grick.actions.3.name: Tentacles
grick.actions.3.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12) from all four tentacles.
grick.name: Grick

griffon.actions.2.name: Rend

griffon.name: Griffon
grimlock.actions.1.name: Bone Cudgel

grimlock.name: Grimlock

guardian-naga.special.1.desc: If the naga dies, it returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its Hit Points unless Dispel Evil and Good is cast on its remains.
guardian-naga.actions.1.name: Multiattack
guardian-naga.actions.1.desc: The naga makes two Bite attacks. It can replace any attack with a use of Poisonous Spittle.
guardian-naga.actions.2.name: Bite

guardian-naga.actions.3.name: Poisonous Spittle
guardian-naga.actions.3.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the naga can see within 60 feet. Failure: 31 (7d8) Poison damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the start of the naga’s next turn. Success: Half damage only.
guardian-naga.actions.4.name: Spellcasting
guardian-naga.actions.4.desc: The naga casts one of the following spells, requiring no Somatic or Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):
guardian-naga.name: Guardian Naga
guard.actions.1.name: Spear
guard.actions.1.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Piercing damage.
guard.name: Guard
guard-captain.actions.1.name: Multiattack
guard-captain.actions.1.desc: The guard makes two attacks, using Javelin or Longsword in any combination.
guard-captain.actions.2.name: Javelin
guard-captain.actions.2.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) Piercing damage.
guard-captain.actions.3.name: Longsword
guard-captain.actions.3.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Slashing damage.

half-dragon.special.1.name: Draconic Origin
half-dragon.special.1.desc: The half-dragon is related to a type of dragon associated with one of the following damage types (GM’s choice): Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison. This choice affects other aspects of the stat block.
half-dragon.actions.1.name: Multiattack
half-dragon.actions.1.desc: The half-dragon makes two Claw attacks.
half-dragon.actions.2.name: Claw
half-dragon.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) damage of the type chosen for the Draconic Origin trait.
half-dragon.actions.3.name: Dragon’s Breath
half-dragon.actions.3.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 28 (8d6) damage of the type chosen for the Draconic Origin trait. Success: Half damage.
half-dragon.bonusActions.1.name: Leap
half-dragon.bonusActions.1.desc: The half-dragon jumps up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.
half-dragon.name: Half-Dragon
half-dragon.resistances: damage type chosen for the draconic origin trait below
harpy.actions.1.name: Claw
harpy.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) Slashing damage.
harpy.actions.2.name: Luring Song
harpy.actions.2.desc: The harpy sings a magical melody, which lasts until the harpy’s Concentration ends on it. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, each Humanoid and Giant in a 300-foot Emanation originating from the harpy when the song starts. Failure: The target has the Charmed condition until the song ends and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. While Charmed, the target has the Incapacitated condition and ignores the Luring Song of other harpies. If the target is more than 5 feet from the harpy, the target moves on its turn toward the harpy by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet of the harpy. It doesn’t avoid Opportunity Attacks; however, before moving into damaging terrain (such as lava or a pit) and whenever it takes damage from a source other than the harpy, the target repeats the save. Success: The target is immune to this harpy’s Luring Song for 24 hours.
harpy.name: Harpy
hell-hound.special.1.name: Pack Tactics
hell-hound.special.1.desc: The hound has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hound’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.
hell-hound.actions.1.name: Multiattack
hell-hound.actions.1.desc: The hound makes two Bite attacks.
hell-hound.actions.2.name: Bite
hell-hound.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.
hell-hound.actions.3.name: Fire Breath
hell-hound.actions.3.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 17 (5d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.
hell-hound.name: Hell Hound
hezrou.special.1.name: Demonic Restoration
hezrou.special.1.desc: If the hezrou dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.
hezrou.special.2.name: Magic Resistance
hezrou.special.2.desc: The hezrou has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
hezrou.special.3.name: Stench
hezrou.special.3.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, any creature that starts its turn in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the hezrou. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition until the start of its next turn.
hezrou.actions.1.name: Multiattack
hezrou.actions.1.desc: The hezrou makes three Rend attacks.
hezrou.actions.2.name: Rend
hezrou.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Poison damage.
hezrou.bonusActions.1.name: Leap
hezrou.bonusActions.1.desc: The hezrou jumps up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.
hezrou.name: Hezrou

hill-giant.actions.1.desc: The giant makes two attacks, using Tree Club or Trash Lob in any combination.
hill-giant.actions.2.name: Tree Club
hill-giant.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.
hill-giant.actions.3.name: Trash Lob
hill-giant.actions.3.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +8, range 60/240 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.
hill-giant.name: Hill Giant
hippogriff.special.1.name: Flyby
hippogriff.special.1.desc: The hippogriff doesn’t provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy’s reach.
hippogriff.actions.1.name: Multiattack
hippogriff.actions.1.desc: The hippogriff makes two Rend attacks.
hippogriff.actions.2.name: Rend
hippogriff.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage.
hippogriff.name: Hippogriff
