hobgoblin-warrior.actions.1.name: Longsword
hobgoblin-warrior.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d10 + 1) Slashing damage.
hobgoblin-warrior.actions.2.name: Longbow
hobgoblin-warrior.actions.2.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +3, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage plus 7 (3d4) Poison damage.
hobgoblin-warrior.name: Hobgoblin Warrior
hobgoblin-captain.special.1.name: Aura of Authority
hobgoblin-captain.special.1.desc: While in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the hobgoblin, the hobgoblin and its allies have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws, provided the hobgoblin doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.
hobgoblin-captain.actions.1.name: Multiattack
hobgoblin-captain.actions.1.desc: The hobgoblin makes two attacks, using Greatsword or Longbow in any combination.
hobgoblin-captain.actions.2.name: Greatsword
hobgoblin-captain.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage.
hobgoblin-captain.actions.3.name: Longbow
hobgoblin-captain.actions.3.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) Poison damage.
hobgoblin-captain.name: Hobgoblin Captain
homunculus.special.1.name: Telepathic Bond
homunculus.special.1.desc: While the homunculus is on the same plane of existence as its master, the two of them can communicate telepathically with each other.
homunculus.actions.1.name: Bite
homunculus.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage, and the target is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition until the end of the homunculus’s next turn. Failure by 5 or More: The target has the Poisoned condition for 1 minute. While Poisoned, the target has the Unconscious condition, which ends early if the target takes any damage.
homunculus.name: Homunculus
homunculus.languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can’t speak
horned-devil.special.1.name: Diabolical Restoration
horned-devil.special.1.desc: If the devil dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.
horned-devil.special.2.name: Magic Resistance
horned-devil.special.2.desc: The devil has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
horned-devil.actions.1.name: Multiattack
horned-devil.actions.1.desc: The devil makes three attacks, using Searing Fork or Hurl Flame in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Infernal Tail.
horned-devil.actions.2.name: Searing Fork
horned-devil.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Fire damage.
horned-devil.actions.3.name: Hurl Flame
horned-devil.actions.3.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +8, range 150 ft. Hit: 26 (5d8 + 4) Fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn’t being worn or carried, it starts burning.
horned-devil.actions.4.name: Infernal Tail
horned-devil.actions.4.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature the devil can see within 10 feet. Failure: 10 (1d8 + 6) Necrotic damage, and the target receives an infernal wound if it doesn’t have one. While wounded, the target loses 10 (3d6) Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. The wound closes after 1 minute, after a spell restores Hit Points to the target, or after the target or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to stanch the wound, doing so by succeeding on a DC 17 Wisdom (Medicine) check.
horned-devil.name: Horned Devil
hydra.special.1.name: Hold Breath
hydra.special.1.desc: The hydra can hold its breath for 1 hour.
hydra.special.2.name: Multiple Heads
hydra.special.2.desc: The hydra has five heads. Whenever the hydra takes 25 damage or more on a single turn, one of its heads dies. The hydra dies if all its heads are dead. At the end of each of its turns when it has at least one living head, the hydra grows two heads for each of its heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken Fire damage since its last turn. The hydra regains 20 Hit Points when it grows new heads.
hydra.special.3.name: Reactive Heads
hydra.special.3.desc: For each head the hydra has beyond one, it gets an extra Reaction that can be used only for Opportunity Attacks.
hydra.actions.1.name: Multiattack
hydra.actions.1.desc: The hydra makes as many Bite attacks as it has heads.
hydra.actions.2.name: Bite
hydra.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) Piercing damage.
hydra.name: Hydra
ice-devil.special.1.name: Diabolical Restoration
ice-devil.special.1.desc: If the devil dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.
ice-devil.special.2.name: Magic Resistance
ice-devil.special.2.desc: The devil has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
ice-devil.actions.1.name: Multiattack
ice-devil.actions.1.desc: The devil makes three Ice Spear attacks. It can replace one attack with a Tail attack.
ice-devil.actions.2.name: Ice Spear
ice-devil.actions.2.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Cold damage. Until the end of its next turn, the target can’t take a Bonus Action or Reaction, its Speed decreases by 10 feet, and it can move or take one action on its turn, not both. Hit or Miss: The spear magically returns to the devil’s hand immediately after a ranged attack.
ice-devil.actions.3.name: Tail
ice-devil.actions.3.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) Cold damage.
ice-devil.actions.4.name: Ice Wall
ice-devil.actions.4.desc: The devil casts Wall of Ice (level 8 version), requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17).
ice-devil.name: Ice Devil
imp.special.1.name: Magic Resistance
imp.special.1.desc: The imp has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
imp.actions.1.name: Sting
imp.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.
imp.actions.2.name: Invisibility
imp.actions.2.desc: The imp casts Invisibility on itself, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.
imp.actions.3.name: Shape-Shift
imp.actions.3.desc: The imp shape-shifts to resemble a rat (Speed 20 ft.), a raven (20 ft., Fly 60 ft.), or a spider (20 ft., Climb 20 ft.), or it returns to its true form. Its game statistics are the same in each form, except for its Speed. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed.
imp.name: Imp
incubus.special.1.name: Succubus Form
incubus.special.1.desc: When the incubus finishes a Long Rest, it can shape-shift into a Succubus, using that stat block instead of this one. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed.
incubus.actions.1.name: Multiattack
incubus.actions.1.desc: The incubus makes two Restless Touch attacks.
incubus.actions.2.name: Restless Touch
incubus.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) Psychic damage, and the target is cursed for 24 hours or until the incubus dies. Until the curse ends, the target gains no benefit from finishing Short Rests.
incubus.actions.3.name: Spellcasting
incubus.actions.3.desc: The incubus casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):
incubus.bonusActions.1.name: Nightmare
incubus.bonusActions.1.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature the incubus can see within 60 feet. Failure: If the target has 20 Hit Points or fewer, it has the Unconscious condition for 1 hour, until it takes damage, or until a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it. Otherwise, the target takes 18 (4d8) Psychic damage.
incubus.name: Incubus
invisible-stalker.special.1.name: Air Form
invisible-stalker.special.1.desc: The stalker can enter an enemy’s space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.
invisible-stalker.special.2.name: Invisibility
invisible-stalker.special.2.desc: The stalker has the Invisible condition.
invisible-stalker.actions.1.name: Multiattack
invisible-stalker.actions.1.desc: The stalker makes three Wind Swipe attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Vortex.
invisible-stalker.actions.2.name: Wind Swipe
invisible-stalker.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Force damage.
invisible-stalker.actions.3.name: Vortex
invisible-stalker.actions.3.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, one Large or smaller creature in the stalker’s space. Failure: 7 (1d8 + 3) Thunder damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). Until the grapple ends, the target can’t cast spells with a Verbal component and takes 7 (2d6) Thunder damage at the start of each of the stalker’s turns.
invisible-stalker.name: Invisible Stalker
iron-golem.special.1.name: Fire Absorption
iron-golem.special.1.desc: Whenever the golem is subjected to Fire damage, it regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Fire damage dealt.
iron-golem.special.2.name: Immutable Form
iron-golem.special.3.name: Magic Resistance
iron-golem.special.3.desc: The golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
iron-golem.actions.1.name: Multiattack
iron-golem.actions.1.desc: The golem makes two attacks, using Bladed Arm or Fiery Bolt in any combination.
iron-golem.actions.2.name: Bladed Arm
iron-golem.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 10 ft. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.
iron-golem.actions.3.name: Fiery Bolt
iron-golem.actions.3.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +10, range 120 ft. Hit: 36 (8d8) Fire damage.
iron-golem.actions.4.name: Poison Breath
iron-golem.actions.4.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. Failure: 55 (10d10) Poison damage. Success: Half damage.
iron-golem.name: Iron Golem
iron-golem.languages: Understands Common plus two other languages but can’t speak
knight.actions.1.name: Multiattack
knight.actions.1.desc: The knight makes two attacks, using Greatsword or Heavy Crossbow in any combination.
knight.actions.2.name: Greatsword
knight.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Radiant damage.
knight.actions.3.name: Heavy Crossbow
knight.actions.3.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +2, range 100/400 ft. Hit: 11 (2d10) Piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) Radiant damage.
knight.reactions.1.name: Parry
knight.reactions.1.desc: Trigger: The knight is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The knight adds 2 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.
knight.name: Knight
kobold-warrior.special.1.name: Pack Tactics
kobold-warrior.special.1.desc: The kobold has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.
kobold-warrior.special.2.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
kobold-warrior.special.2.desc: While in sunlight, the kobold has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.
kobold-warrior.actions.1.name: Dagger
kobold-warrior.actions.1.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage.
kobold-warrior.name: Kobold Warrior
kraken.special.1.name: Amphibious
kraken.special.1.desc: The kraken can breathe air and water.
kraken.special.2.name: Legendary Resistance
kraken.special.2.desc: If the kraken fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
kraken.special.3.name: Siege Monster
kraken.special.3.desc: The kraken deals double damage to objects and structures.
kraken.actions.1.name: Multiattack
kraken.actions.1.desc: The kraken makes two Tentacle attacks and uses Fling, Lightning Strike, or Swallow.
kraken.actions.2.name: Tentacle
kraken.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +17, reach 30 ft. Hit: 24 (4d6 + 10) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 20) from one of ten tentacles, and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.
kraken.actions.3.name: Fling
kraken.actions.3.desc: The kraken throws a Large or smaller creature Grappled by it to a space it can see within 60 feet of itself that isn’t in the air. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 25, the creature thrown and each creature in the destination space. Failure: 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.
kraken.actions.4.name: Lightning Strike
kraken.actions.4.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 23, one creature the kraken can see within 120 feet. Failure: 33 (6d10) Lightning damage. Success: Half damage.
kraken.actions.5.name: Swallow
kraken.actions.5.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 25, one creature Grappled by the kraken (it can have up to four creatures swallowed at a time). Failure: 23 (3d8 + 10) Piercing damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it is swallowed and no longer Grappled. A swallowed creature has the Restrained condition, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the kraken, and takes 24 (7d6) Acid damage at the start of each of its turns. If the kraken takes 50 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the kraken must succeed on a DC 25 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the kraken with the Prone condition. If the kraken dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting Prone.
kraken.legendary.1.name: Storm Bolt
kraken.legendary.2.name: Toxic Ink
kraken.legendary.2.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 23, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the kraken while it is underwater. Failure: The target has the Blinded and Poisoned conditions until the end of the kraken’s next turn. The kraken then moves up to its Speed. Failure or Success: The kraken can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.
kraken.name: Kraken
kraken.languages: Understands Abyssal, Celestial, Infernal, and Primordial but can’t speak; telepathy 120 ft.
lamia.actions.1.name: Multiattack
lamia.actions.1.desc: The lamia makes two Claw attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Corrupting Touch.
lamia.actions.2.name: Claw
lamia.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Psychic damage.
lamia.actions.3.name: Corrupting Touch
lamia.actions.3.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 13, one creature the lamia can see within 5 feet. Failure: 13 (3d8) Psychic damage, and the target is cursed for 1 hour. Until the curse ends, the target has the Charmed and Poisoned conditions.
lamia.actions.4.name: Spellcasting
lamia.actions.4.desc: The lamia casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):
lamia.bonusActions.1.name: Leap
lamia.bonusActions.1.desc: The lamia jumps up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.
lamia.name: Lamia
lemure.special.1.name: Hellish Restoration
lemure.special.1.desc: If the lemure dies in the Nine Hells, it revives with all its Hit Points in 1d10 days unless it is killed by a creature under the effects of a Bless spell or its remains are sprinkled with Holy Water.
lemure.actions.1.name: Vile Slime
lemure.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 2 (1d4) Poison damage.
lemure.name: Lemure
lich.special.1.name: Legendary Resistance
lich.special.1.desc: If the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
lich.special.2.name: Spirit Jar
lich.special.2.desc: If destroyed, the lich reforms in 1d10 days if it has a spirit jar, reviving with all its Hit Points. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within the lich’s lair.
lich.actions.1.name: Multiattack
lich.actions.1.desc: The lich makes three attacks, using Eldritch Burst or Paralyzing Touch in any combination.
lich.actions.2.name: Eldritch Burst
lich.actions.2.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +12, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 31 (4d12 + 5) Force damage.
lich.actions.3.name: Paralyzing Touch
lich.actions.3.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) Cold damage, and the target has the Paralyzed condition until the start of the lich’s next turn.
lich.actions.4.name: Spellcasting
lich.actions.4.desc: The lich casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20):
lich.reactions.1.name: Protective Magic
lich.reactions.1.desc: The lich casts Counterspell or Shield in response to the spell’s trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
lich.legendary.1.name: Deathly Teleport
lich.legendary.1.desc: The lich teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, and each creature within 10 feet of the space it left takes 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage.
lich.legendary.2.name: Disrupt Life
lich.legendary.2.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20, each creature that isn’t an Undead in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the lich. Failure: 31 (9d6) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: The lich can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.
lich.legendary.3.name: Frightening Gaze
lich.legendary.3.desc: The lich casts Fear, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. The lich can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.
lich.name: Lich
mage.actions.1.name: Multiattack
mage.actions.1.desc: The mage makes three Arcane Burst attacks.
mage.actions.2.name: Arcane Burst
mage.actions.2.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 16 (3d8 + 3) Force damage.
mage.actions.3.name: Spellcasting
mage.actions.3.desc: The mage casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):
mage.bonusActions.1.name: Misty Step
mage.bonusActions.1.desc: The mage casts Misty Step, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
mage.reactions.1.name: Protective Magic
mage.reactions.1.desc: The mage casts Counterspell or Shield in response to the spell’s trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
mage.name: Mage
archmage.special.1.name: Magic Resistance
archmage.special.1.desc: The archmage has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
archmage.actions.1.name: Multiattack
archmage.actions.1.desc: The archmage makes four Arcane Burst attacks.
archmage.actions.2.name: Arcane Burst
archmage.actions.2.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. or range 150 ft. Hit: 27 (4d10 + 5) Force damage.
archmage.actions.3.name: Spellcasting
archmage.actions.3.desc: The archmage casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):
archmage.bonusActions.1.name: Misty Step
archmage.bonusActions.1.desc: The mage casts Misty Step, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
archmage.reactions.1.name: Protective Magic
archmage.reactions.1.desc: The archmage casts Counterspell or Shield in response to the spell’s trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
archmage.name: Archmage
magmin.special.1.name: Death Burst
magmin.special.1.desc: The magmin explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the magmin. Failure: 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.
magmin.actions.1.name: Touch
magmin.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object that isn’t being worn or carried, it starts burning.
magmin.bonusActions.1.name: Ignited Illumination
magmin.bonusActions.1.desc: The magmin sets itself ablaze or extinguishes its flames. While ablaze, the magmin sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.
magmin.name: Magmin
manticore.actions.1.name: Multiattack
manticore.actions.1.desc: The manticore makes three attacks, using Rend or Tail Spike in any combination.
manticore.actions.2.name: Rend
manticore.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage.
manticore.actions.3.name: Tail Spike
manticore.actions.3.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 100/200 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage.
manticore.name: Manticore
marilith.special.1.name: Demonic Restoration
marilith.special.1.desc: If the marilith dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.
marilith.special.2.name: Magic Resistance
marilith.special.2.desc: The marilith has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
marilith.special.3.name: Reactive
marilith.special.3.desc: The marilith can take one Reaction on every turn of combat.
marilith.actions.1.name: Multiattack
marilith.actions.1.desc: The marilith makes six Pact Blade attacks and uses Constrict.
marilith.actions.2.name: Pact Blade
marilith.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.
marilith.actions.3.name: Constrict
marilith.actions.3.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 17, one Medium or smaller creature the marilith can see within 5 feet. Failure: 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.
marilith.bonusActions.1.name: Teleport
marilith.bonusActions.1.desc: The marilith teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.
marilith.reactions.1.name: Parry
marilith.reactions.1.desc: Trigger: The marilith is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The marilith adds 5 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.
marilith.name: Marilith
medusa.actions.1.name: Multiattack
medusa.actions.1.desc: The medusa makes two Claw attacks and one Snake Hair attack, or it makes three Poison Ray attacks.
medusa.actions.2.name: Claw
medusa.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage.
medusa.actions.3.name: Snake Hair
medusa.actions.3.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage.
medusa.actions.4.name: Poison Ray
medusa.actions.4.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 150 ft. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) Poison damage.
medusa.bonusActions.1.name: Petrifying Gaze
medusa.bonusActions.1.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. If the medusa sees its reflection in the Cone, the medusa must make this save. First Failure: The target has the Restrained condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. Second Failure: The target has the Petrified condition instead of the Restrained condition.
medusa.name: Medusa
dust-mephit.special.1.name: Death Burst
dust-mephit.special.1.desc: The mephit explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the mephit. Failure: 5 (2d4) Bludgeoning damage. Success: Half damage.
dust-mephit.actions.1.name: Claw
dust-mephit.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Slashing damage.
dust-mephit.actions.2.name: Blinding Breath
dust-mephit.actions.2.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: The target has the Blinded condition until the end of the mephit’s next turn.
dust-mephit.actions.3.name: Sleep
dust-mephit.actions.3.desc: The mephit casts the Sleep spell, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 10).
dust-mephit.name: Dust Mephit
ice-mephit.special.1.name: Death Burst
ice-mephit.special.1.desc: The mephit explodes when it dies. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the mephit. Failure: 5 (2d4) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.
ice-mephit.actions.1.name: Claw
ice-mephit.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Cold damage.
ice-mephit.actions.2.name: Fog Cloud
ice-mephit.actions.2.desc: The mephit casts Fog Cloud, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.
ice-mephit.actions.3.name: Frost Breath
ice-mephit.actions.3.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 7 (3d4) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.
ice-mephit.name: Ice Mephit
magma-mephit.special.1.name: Death Burst
magma-mephit.special.1.desc: The mephit explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the mephit. Failure: 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.
magma-mephit.actions.1.name: Claw
magma-mephit.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.
magma-mephit.actions.2.name: Fire Breath
magma-mephit.actions.2.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.
magma-mephit.name: Magma Mephit
steam-mephit.special.1.name: Blurred Form
steam-mephit.special.1.desc: Attack rolls against the mephit are made with Disadvantage unless the mephit has the Incapacitated condition.
steam-mephit.special.2.name: Death Burst
steam-mephit.special.2.desc: The mephit explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the mephit. Failure: 5 (2d4) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.
steam-mephit.actions.1.name: Claw
steam-mephit.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 2 (1d4) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Fire damage.
steam-mephit.actions.2.name: Steam Breath
steam-mephit.actions.2.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 5 (2d4) Fire damage, and the target’s Speed decreases by 10 feet until the end of the mephit’s next turn. Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: Being underwater doesn’t grant Resistance to this Fire damage.
steam-mephit.name: Steam Mephit
merfolk-skirmisher.special.1.name: Amphibious
merfolk-skirmisher.special.1.desc: The merfolk can breathe air and water.
merfolk-skirmisher.actions.1.name: Ocean Spear
merfolk-skirmisher.actions.1.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 3 (1d6) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Cold damage. If the target is a creature, its Speed decreases by 10 feet until the end of its next turn. Hit or Miss: The spear magically returns to the merfolk’s hand immediately after a ranged attack.
merfolk-skirmisher.name: Merfolk Skirmisher
merrow.special.1.name: Amphibious
merrow.special.1.desc: The merrow can breathe air and water.
merrow.actions.1.name: Multiattack
merrow.actions.1.desc: The merrow makes two attacks, using Bite, Claw, or Harpoon in any combination.
merrow.actions.2.name: Bite
merrow.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of the merrow’s next turn.
merrow.actions.3.name: Claw
merrow.actions.3.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) Slashing damage.
merrow.actions.4.name: Harpoon
merrow.actions.4.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the merrow pulls the target up to 15 feet straight toward itself.
merrow.name: Merrow
mimic.special.1.name: Adhesive (Object Form Only)
mimic.special.1.desc: The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mimic has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have Disadvantage.
mimic.actions.1.name: Bite
mimic.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5 (with Advantage if the target is Grappled by the mimic), reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage—or 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage if the target is Grappled by the mimic—plus 4 (1d8) Acid damage.
mimic.actions.2.name: Pseudopod
mimic.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) Acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have Disadvantage.
mimic.bonusActions.1.name: Shape-Shift
mimic.bonusActions.1.desc: The mimic shape-shifts to resemble a Medium or Small object while retaining its game statistics, or it returns to its true blob form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed.
mimic.name: Mimic
minotaur-of-baphomet.actions.1.name: Abyssal Glaive
minotaur-of-baphomet.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage.
minotaur-of-baphomet.actions.2.name: Gore
minotaur-of-baphomet.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the minotaur moved 10+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.
minotaur-of-baphomet.name: Minotaur of Baphomet
mummy.actions.1.name: Multiattack
mummy.actions.1.desc: The mummy makes two Rotting Fist attacks and uses Dreadful Glare.
mummy.actions.2.name: Rotting Fist
mummy.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target can’t regain Hit Points, its Hit Point maximum doesn’t return to normal when finishing a Long Rest, and its Hit Point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) every 24 hours that elapse. A creature dies and turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack.
mummy.actions.3.name: Dreadful Glare
mummy.actions.3.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, one creature the mummy can see within 60 feet. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the end of the mummy’s next turn. Success: The target is immune to this mummy’s Dreadful Glare for 24 hours.
mummy.name: Mummy
mummy-lord.special.1.name: Legendary Resistance
mummy-lord.special.1.desc: If the mummy fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
mummy-lord.special.2.name: Magic Resistance
mummy-lord.special.2.desc: The mummy has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
mummy-lord.special.3.name: Undead Restoration
mummy-lord.special.3.desc: If destroyed, the mummy gains a new body in 24 hours if its heart is intact, reviving with all its Hit Points. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within the mummy’s lair. The heart is a Tiny object that has AC 17, HP 10, and Immunity to all damage except Fire.
mummy-lord.actions.1.name: Multiattack
mummy-lord.actions.1.desc: The mummy makes one Rotting Fist or Channel Negative Energy attack, and it uses Dreadful Glare.
mummy-lord.actions.2.name: Rotting Fist
mummy-lord.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target can’t regain Hit Points, it gains no benefit from finishing a Long Rest, and its Hit Point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) every 24 hours that elapse. A creature dies and turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack.
mummy-lord.actions.3.name: Channel Negative Energy
mummy-lord.actions.3.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 60 ft. Hit: 25 (6d6 + 4) Necrotic damage.
mummy-lord.actions.4.name: Dreadful Glare
mummy-lord.actions.4.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature the mummy can see within 60 feet. Failure: 25 (6d6 + 4) Psychic damage, and the target has the Paralyzed condition until the end of the mummy’s next turn.
mummy-lord.actions.5.name: Spellcasting
mummy-lord.actions.5.desc: The mummy casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks):
mummy-lord.reactions.1.name: Whirlwind of Sand
mummy-lord.reactions.1.desc: Trigger: The mummy is hit by an attack roll. Response: The mummy adds 2 to its AC against the attack, possibly causing the attack to miss, and the mummy teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Each creature of its choice that it can see within 5 feet of its destination space has the Blinded condition until the end of the mummy’s next turn.
mummy-lord.legendary.1.name: Dread Command
mummy-lord.legendary.1.desc: The mummy casts Command (level 2 version), using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. The mummy can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.
mummy-lord.legendary.2.name: Glare
mummy-lord.legendary.2.desc: The mummy uses Dreadful Glare. The mummy can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.
mummy-lord.legendary.3.name: Necrotic Strike
mummy-lord.legendary.3.desc: The mummy makes one Rotting Fist or Channel Negative Energy attack.
mummy-lord.name: Mummy Lord
nalfeshnee.special.1.name: Demonic Restoration
nalfeshnee.special.1.desc: If the nalfeshnee dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.
nalfeshnee.special.2.name: Magic Resistance
nalfeshnee.special.2.desc: The nalfeshnee has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
nalfeshnee.actions.1.name: Multiattack
nalfeshnee.actions.1.desc: The nalfeshnee makes three Rend attacks.
nalfeshnee.actions.2.name: Rend
nalfeshnee.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) Slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) Force damage.
nalfeshnee.actions.3.name: Teleport
nalfeshnee.actions.3.desc: The nalfeshnee teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.
nalfeshnee.bonusActions.1.name: Horror Nimbus
nalfeshnee.bonusActions.1.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the nalfeshnee. Failure: 28 (8d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition for 1 minute, until it takes damage, or until it ends its turn with the nalfeshnee out of line of sight. Success: The target is immune to this nalfeshnee’s Horror Nimbus for 24 hours.
nalfeshnee.reactions.1.name: Pursuit
nalfeshnee.reactions.1.desc: Trigger: Another creature the nalfeshnee can see ends its move within 120 feet of the nalfeshnee. Response: The nalfeshnee uses Teleport, but its destination space must be within 10 feet of the triggering creature.
nalfeshnee.name: Nalfeshnee
night-hag.special.1.name: Coven Magic
night-hag.special.1.desc: While within 30 feet of at least two hag allies, the hag can cast one of the following spells, requiring no Material components, using the spell’s normal casting time, and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14): Augury, Find Familiar, Identify, Locate Object, Scrying, or Unseen Servant. The hag must finish a Long Rest before using this trait to cast that spell again.
night-hag.special.2.name: Magic Resistance
night-hag.special.2.desc: The hag has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
night-hag.special.3.name: Soul Bag
night-hag.special.3.desc: The hag has a soul bag. While holding or carrying the bag, the hag can use its Nightmare Haunting action. The bag has AC 15, HP 20, and Resistance to all damage. The bag turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points. If the bag is destroyed, any souls the bag is holding are released. The hag can create a new bag after 7 days.
night-hag.actions.1.name: Multiattack
night-hag.actions.1.desc: The hag makes two Claw attacks.
night-hag.actions.2.name: Claw
night-hag.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage.
night-hag.actions.3.name: Nightmare Haunting (Requires Soul Bag)
night-hag.actions.3.desc: While on the Ethereal Plane, the hag casts Dream, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. Only the hag can serve as the spell’s messenger, and the target must be a creature the hag can see on the Material Plane. The spell fails and is wasted if the target is under the effect of the Protection from Evil and Good spell or within a Magic Circle spell. If the target takes damage from the Dream spell, the target’s Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to that damage. If the spell kills the target, its soul is trapped in the hag’s soul bag, and the target can’t be raised from the dead until its soul is released.
night-hag.actions.4.name: Spellcasting
night-hag.actions.4.desc: The hag casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):
night-hag.bonusActions.1.name: Shape-Shift
night-hag.bonusActions.1.desc: The hag shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid, or it returns to its true form. Other than its size, its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed.
night-hag.name: Night Hag
nightmare.special.1.name: Confer Fire Resistance
nightmare.special.1.desc: The nightmare can grant Resistance to Fire damage to a rider while it is on the nightmare.
nightmare.special.2.name: Illumination
nightmare.special.2.desc: The nightmare sheds Bright Light in a 10foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.
nightmare.actions.1.name: Hooves
nightmare.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.
nightmare.actions.2.name: Ethereal Stride
nightmare.actions.2.desc: The nightmare and up to three willing creatures within 5 feet of it teleport to the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane or vice versa.
nightmare.name: Nightmare
nightmare.languages: Understands Abyssal, Common, and Infernal but can’t speak
noble.actions.1.name: Rapier
noble.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage.
noble.reactions.1.name: Parry
noble.reactions.1.desc: Trigger: The noble is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The noble adds 2 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.
noble.name: Noble
ochre-jelly.special.1.name: Amorphous
ochre-jelly.special.1.desc: The jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.
ochre-jelly.special.2.name: Spider Climb
ochre-jelly.special.2.desc: The jelly can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
ochre-jelly.actions.1.name: Pseudopod
ochre-jelly.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) Acid damage.
ochre-jelly.reactions.1.name: Split
ochre-jelly.reactions.1.desc: Trigger: While the jelly is Large or Medium and has 10+ Hit Points, it becomes Bloodied or is subjected to Lightning or Slashing damage. Response: The jelly splits into two new Ochre Jellies. Each new jelly is one size smaller than the original jelly and acts on its Initiative. The original jelly’s Hit Points are divided evenly between the new jellies (round down).
ochre-jelly.name: Ochre Jelly
ogre.actions.1.name: Greatclub
ogre.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.
ogre.actions.2.name: Javelin
ogre.actions.2.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage.
ogre.name: Ogre
oni.special.1.name: Regeneration
oni.special.1.desc: The oni regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point.
oni.actions.1.name: Multiattack
oni.actions.1.desc: The oni makes two Claw or Nightmare Ray attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.
oni.actions.2.name: Claw
oni.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage.
oni.actions.3.name: Nightmare Ray
oni.actions.3.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 60 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the oni’s next turn.
oni.actions.4.name: Shape-Shift
oni.actions.4.desc: The oni shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid or a Large Giant, or it returns to its true form. Other than its size, its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed.
oni.actions.5.name: Spellcasting
oni.actions.5.desc: The oni casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):
oni.bonusActions.1.name: Invisibility
oni.bonusActions.1.desc: The oni casts Invisibility on itself, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
oni.name: Oni
otyugh.actions.1.name: Multiattack
otyugh.actions.1.desc: The otyugh makes one Bite attack and two Tentacle attacks.
otyugh.actions.2.name: Bite
otyugh.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition. Whenever the Poisoned target finishes a Long Rest, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The target’s Hit Point maximum decreases by 5 (1d10) and doesn’t return to normal until the Poisoned condition ends on the target. Success: The Poisoned condition ends.
otyugh.actions.3.name: Tentacle
otyugh.actions.3.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13) from one of two tentacles.
otyugh.actions.4.name: Tentacle Slam
otyugh.actions.4.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature Grappled by the otyugh. Failure: 16 (3d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the start of the otyugh’s next turn. Success: Half damage only.
otyugh.name: Otyugh
otyugh.languages: Otyugh; telepathy 120 ft. (doesn’t allow the receiving creature to respond telepathically)
owlbear.actions.1.name: Multiattack
owlbear.actions.1.desc: The owlbear makes two Rend attacks.
owlbear.actions.2.name: Rend
owlbear.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage.
owlbear.name: Owlbear
pegasus.actions.1.name: Hooves
pegasus.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) Radiant damage.
pegasus.name: Pegasus
pegasus.languages: Understands Celestial, Common, Elvish, and Sylvan but can’t speak
phase-spider.special.1.name: Ethereal Sight
phase-spider.special.1.desc: The spider can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane while on the Material Plane and vice versa.
phase-spider.special.2.name: Spider Climb
phase-spider.special.2.desc: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
phase-spider.special.3.name: Web Walker
phase-spider.special.3.desc: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the spider knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.
phase-spider.actions.1.name: Multiattack
phase-spider.actions.1.desc: The spider makes two Bite attacks.
phase-spider.actions.2.name: Bite
phase-spider.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Poison damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, the target becomes Stable, and it has the Poisoned condition for 1 hour. While Poisoned, the target also has the Paralyzed condition.
phase-spider.bonusActions.1.name: Ethereal Jaunt
phase-spider.bonusActions.1.desc: The spider teleports from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane or vice versa.
phase-spider.name: Phase Spider
pirate.actions.1.name: Multiattack
pirate.actions.1.desc: The pirate makes two Dagger attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Enthralling Panache.
pirate.actions.2.name: Dagger
pirate.actions.2.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage.
pirate.actions.3.name: Enthralling Panache
pirate.actions.3.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, one creature the pirate can see within 30 feet. Failure: The target has the Charmed condition until the start of the pirate’s next turn.
pirate.name: Pirate
pirate-captain.actions.1.name: Multiattack
pirate-captain.actions.1.desc: The pirate makes three attacks, using Rapier or Pistol in any combination.
pirate-captain.actions.2.name: Rapier
pirate-captain.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage, and the pirate has Advantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of this turn.
pirate-captain.actions.3.name: Pistol
pirate-captain.actions.3.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 30/90 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Piercing damage.
pirate-captain.reactions.1.name: Riposte
pirate-captain.reactions.1.desc: Trigger: The pirate is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The pirate adds 3 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss. On a miss, the pirate makes one Rapier attack against the triggering creature if within range.
pirate-captain.name: Pirate Captain
pit-fiend.special.1.name: Diabolical Restoration
pit-fiend.special.1.desc: If the pit fiend dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.
pit-fiend.special.2.name: Fear Aura
pit-fiend.special.2.desc: The pit fiend emanates an aura in a 20foot Emanation while it doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 21, any enemy that starts its turn in the aura. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn. Success: The target is immune to this pit fiend’s aura for 24 hours.
pit-fiend.special.3.name: Legendary Resistance
pit-fiend.special.3.desc: If the pit fiend fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
pit-fiend.special.4.name: Magic Resistance
pit-fiend.special.4.desc: The pit fiend has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
pit-fiend.actions.1.name: Multiattack
pit-fiend.actions.1.desc: The pit fiend makes one Bite attack, two Devilish Claw attacks, and one Fiery Mace attack.
pit-fiend.actions.2.name: Bite
pit-fiend.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (3d6 + 8) Piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must make the following saving throw. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 21. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition. While Poisoned, the target can’t regain Hit Points and takes 21 (6d6) Poison damage at the start of each of its turns, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.
pit-fiend.actions.3.name: Devilish Claw
pit-fiend.actions.3.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. Hit: 26 (4d8 + 8) Necrotic damage.
pit-fiend.actions.4.name: Fiery Mace
pit-fiend.actions.4.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. Hit: 22 (4d6 + 8) Force damage plus 21 (6d6) Fire damage.
pit-fiend.actions.5.name: Hellfire Spellcasting
pit-fiend.actions.5.desc: The pit fiend casts Fireball (level 5 version) twice, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 21). It can replace one Fireball with Hold Monster (level 7 version) or Wall of Fire.
pit-fiend.name: Pit Fiend
planetar.special.1.name: Divine Awareness
planetar.special.1.desc: The planetar knows if it hears a lie.
planetar.special.2.name: Exalted Restoration
planetar.special.2.desc: If the planetar dies outside Mount Celestia, its body disappears, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in Mount Celestia.
planetar.special.3.name: Magic Resistance
planetar.special.3.desc: The planetar has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
planetar.actions.1.name: Multiattack
planetar.actions.1.desc: The planetar makes three Radiant Sword attacks or uses Holy Burst twice.
planetar.actions.2.name: Radiant Sword
planetar.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) Slashing damage plus 18 (4d8) Radiant damage.
planetar.actions.3.name: Holy Burst
planetar.actions.3.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 20, each enemy in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the planetar can see within 120 feet. Failure: 24 (7d6) Radiant damage. Success: Half damage.
planetar.actions.4.name: Spellcasting
planetar.actions.4.desc: The planetar casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20):
planetar.bonusActions.1.name: Divine Aid
planetar.bonusActions.1.desc: The planetar casts Cure Wounds, Invisibility, Lesser Restoration, or Remove Curse, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
planetar.name: Planetar
priest-acolyte.actions.1.name: Mace
priest-acolyte.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) Radiant damage.
priest-acolyte.actions.2.name: Radiant Flame
priest-acolyte.actions.2.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 60 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) Radiant damage.
priest-acolyte.actions.3.name: Spellcasting
priest-acolyte.actions.3.desc: The priest casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability:
priest-acolyte.bonusActions.1.name: Divine Aid
priest-acolyte.bonusActions.1.desc: The priest casts Bless, Healing Word, or Sanctuary, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
priest-acolyte.name: Priest Acolyte
priest.actions.1.name: Multiattack
priest.actions.1.desc: The priest makes two attacks, using Mace or Radiant Flame in any combination.
priest.actions.2.name: Mace
priest.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) Radiant damage.
priest.actions.3.name: Radiant Flame
priest.actions.3.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 60 ft. Hit: 11 (2d10) Radiant damage.
priest.actions.4.name: Spellcasting
priest.actions.4.desc: The priest casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):
priest.bonusActions.1.name: Divine Aid
priest.bonusActions.1.desc: The priest casts Bless, Dispel Magic, Healing Word, or Lesser Restoration, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
priest.name: Priest
pseudodragon.special.1.name: Magic Resistance
pseudodragon.special.1.desc: The pseudodragon has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
pseudodragon.actions.1.name: Multiattack
pseudodragon.actions.1.desc: The pseudodragon makes two Bite attacks.
pseudodragon.actions.2.name: Bite
pseudodragon.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage.
pseudodragon.actions.3.name: Sting
pseudodragon.actions.3.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12, one creature the pseudodragon can see within 5 feet. Failure: 5 (2d4) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition for 1 hour. Failure by 5 or More: While Poisoned, the target also has the Unconscious condition, which ends early if the target takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it.
pseudodragon.name: Pseudodragon
pseudodragon.languages: Understands Common and Draconic but can’t speak
purple-worm.special.1.name: Tunneler
purple-worm.special.1.desc: The worm can burrow through solid rock at half its Burrow Speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.
purple-worm.actions.1.name: Multiattack
purple-worm.actions.1.desc: The worm makes one Bite attack and one Tail Stinger attack.
purple-worm.actions.2.name: Bite
purple-worm.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. Hit: 22 (3d8 + 9) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 19), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.
purple-worm.actions.3.name: Tail Stinger
purple-worm.actions.3.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (2d6 + 9) Piercing damage plus 35 (10d6) Poison damage.
purple-worm.bonusActions.1.name: Swallow
purple-worm.bonusActions.1.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 19, one Large or smaller creature Grappled by the worm (it can have up to three creatures swallowed at a time). Failure: The target is swallowed by the worm, and the Grappled condition ends. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the worm, and takes 17 (5d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the worm’s turns. If the worm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the worm must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 5 feet of the worm and has the Prone condition. If the worm dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 20 feet of movement, exiting Prone.
purple-worm.name: Purple Worm
quasit.special.1.name: Magic Resistance
quasit.special.1.desc: The quasit has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
quasit.actions.1.name: Rend
quasit.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Slashing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the quasit’s next turn.
quasit.actions.2.name: Invisibility
quasit.actions.2.desc: The quasit casts Invisibility on itself, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.
quasit.actions.3.name: Scare
quasit.actions.3.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 10, one creature within 20 feet. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.
quasit.actions.4.name: Shape-Shift
quasit.actions.4.desc: The quasit shape-shifts to resemble a bat (Speed 10 ft., Fly 40 ft.), a centipede (40 ft., Climb 40 ft.), or a toad (40 ft., Swim 40 ft.), or it returns to its true form. Its game statistics are the same in each form, except for its Speed. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed.
quasit.name: Quasit
rakshasa.special.1.name: Greater Magic Resistance
rakshasa.special.1.desc: The rakshasa automatically succeeds on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, and the attack rolls of spells automatically miss it. Without the rakshasa’s permission, no spell can observe the rakshasa remotely or detect its thoughts, creature type, or alignment.
rakshasa.special.2.name: Fiendish Restoration
rakshasa.special.2.desc: If the rakshasa dies outside the Nine Hells, its body turns to ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.
rakshasa.actions.1.name: Multiattack
rakshasa.actions.1.desc: The rakshasa makes three Cursed Touch attacks.
rakshasa.actions.2.name: Cursed Touch
rakshasa.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 19 (3d12) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target gains no benefit from finishing a Short or Long Rest.
rakshasa.actions.3.name: Baleful Command
rakshasa.actions.3.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 18, each enemy in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the rakshasa. Failure: 28 (8d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened and Incapacitated conditions until the start of the rakshasa’s next turn.
rakshasa.actions.4.name: Spellcasting
rakshasa.actions.4.desc: The rakshasa casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):
rakshasa.name: Rakshasa
rakshasa.vulnerabilities: piercing damage from weapons wielded by creatures under the effect of a bless spell
red-dragon-wyrmling.actions.1.name: Multiattack
red-dragon-wyrmling.actions.1.desc: The dragon makes two Rend attacks.
red-dragon-wyrmling.actions.2.name: Rend
red-dragon-wyrmling.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.
red-dragon-wyrmling.actions.3.name: Fire Breath
red-dragon-wyrmling.actions.3.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 24 (7d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.
red-dragon-wyrmling.name: Red Dragon Wyrmling

remorhaz.special.1.name: Heat Aura
remorhaz.special.1.desc: At the end of each of the remorhaz’s turns, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the remorhaz takes 16 (3d10) Fire damage.
remorhaz.actions.1.name: Bite
remorhaz.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Fire damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 17), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.
remorhaz.bonusActions.1.name: Swallow
remorhaz.bonusActions.1.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 19, one Large or smaller creature Grappled by the remorhaz (it can have up to two creatures swallowed at a time). Failure: The target is swallowed by the remorhaz, and the Grappled condition ends. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, it has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the remorhaz, and it takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage at the start of each of the remorhaz’s turns. If the remorhaz takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the remorhaz must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 5 feet of the remorhaz and has the Prone condition. If the remorhaz dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting Prone.
remorhaz.name: Remorhaz
roc.actions.1.name: Multiattack
roc.actions.1.desc: The roc makes two Beak attacks. It can replace one attack with a Talons attack.
roc.actions.2.name: Beak
roc.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +13, reach 10 ft. Hit: 28 (3d12 + 9) Piercing damage.
roc.actions.3.name: Talons
roc.actions.3.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +13, reach 5 ft. Hit: 23 (4d6 + 9) Slashing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 19) from both talons, and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.
roc.bonusActions.1.name: Swoop
roc.bonusActions.1.desc: If the roc has a creature Grappled, the roc flies up to half its Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and drops that creature.
roc.name: Roc
roper.special.1.name: Spider Climb
roper.special.1.desc: The roper can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
roper.actions.1.name: Multiattack
roper.actions.1.desc: The roper makes two Tentacle attacks, uses Reel, and makes two Bite attacks.
roper.actions.2.name: Bite
roper.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) Piercing damage.
roper.actions.3.name: Tentacle
roper.actions.3.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 60 ft. Hit: The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of six tentacles, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the grapple ends. The tentacle can be damaged, freeing a creature it has Grappled when destroyed (AC 20, HP 10, Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage). Damaging the tentacle deals no damage to the roper, and a destroyed tentacle regrows at the start of the roper’s next turn.
roper.actions.4.name: Reel
roper.actions.4.desc: The roper pulls each creature Grappled by it up to 30 feet straight toward it.
roper.name: Roper
rust-monster.special.1.name: Iron Scent
rust-monster.special.1.desc: The rust monster can pinpoint the location of ferrous metal within 30 feet of itself.
rust-monster.actions.1.name: Multiattack
rust-monster.actions.1.desc: The rust monster makes one Bite attack and uses Antennae twice.
rust-monster.actions.2.name: Bite
rust-monster.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage.
rust-monster.actions.3.name: Antennae
rust-monster.actions.3.desc: The rust monster targets one nonmagical metal object—armor or a weapon—worn or carried by a creature within 5 feet of itself. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, the creature with the object. Failure: The object takes a −1 penalty to the AC it offers (armor) or to its attack rolls (weapon). Armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10, and a weapon is destroyed if its penalty reaches −5. The penalty can be removed by casting the Mending spell on the armor or weapon.
rust-monster.actions.4.name: Destroy Metal
rust-monster.actions.4.desc: The rust monster touches a nonmagical metal object within 5 feet of itself that isn’t being worn or carried. The touch destroys a 1-foot Cube of the object.
rust-monster.reactions.1.name: Reflexive Antennae
rust-monster.reactions.1.desc: Trigger: An attack roll hits the rust monster. Response: The rust monster uses Antennae.
rust-monster.name: Rust Monster
sahuagin-warrior.special.1.name: Blood Frenzy
sahuagin-warrior.special.1.desc: The sahuagin has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that doesn’t have all its Hit Points.
sahuagin-warrior.special.2.name: Limited Amphibiousness
sahuagin-warrior.special.2.desc: The sahuagin can breathe air and water, but it must be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating outside water.
sahuagin-warrior.special.3.name: Shark Telepathy
sahuagin-warrior.special.3.desc: The sahuagin can magically control sharks within 120 feet of itself, using a special telepathy.
sahuagin-warrior.actions.1.name: Multiattack
sahuagin-warrior.actions.1.desc: The sahuagin makes two Claw attacks.
sahuagin-warrior.actions.2.name: Claw

sahuagin-warrior.name: Sahuagin Warrior

salamander.actions.1.name: Multiattack
salamander.actions.1.desc: The salamander makes two Flame Spear attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Constrict.
salamander.actions.2.name: Flame Spear
salamander.actions.2.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Hit or Miss: The spear magically returns to the salamander’s hand immediately after a ranged attack.
salamander.actions.3.name: Constrict
salamander.actions.3.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, one Large or smaller creature the salamander can see within 10 feet. Failure: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage. The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.
salamander.name: Salamander
satyr.special.1.name: Magic Resistance

satyr.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the satyr pushes the target up to 10 feet straight away from itself.
satyr.actions.2.name: Mockery
satyr.actions.2.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, one creature the satyr can see within 90 feet. Failure: 5 (1d6 + 2) Psychic damage.
satyr.name: Satyr

scout.actions.3.name: Longbow

scout.name: Scout

The hag must finish a Long Rest before using this trait to cast that spell again.
sea-hag.special.3.name: Vile Appearance
sea-hag.special.3.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, any Beast or Humanoid that starts its turn within 30 feet of the hag and can see the hag’s true form. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn. Success: The target is immune to this hag’s Vile Appearance for 24 hours.
sea-hag.actions.1.name: Claw
sea-hag.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage.
sea-hag.actions.2.name: Death Glare
sea-hag.actions.2.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, one Frightened creature the hag can see within 30 feet. Failure: If the target has 20 Hit Points or fewer, it drops to 0 Hit Points. Otherwise, the target takes 13 (3d8) Psychic damage.
sea-hag.actions.3.name: Illusory Appearance
sea-hag.actions.3.desc: The hag casts Disguise Self, using Constitution as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13). The spell’s duration is 24 hours.
sea-hag.name: Sea Hag

shambling-mound.actions.3.name: Engulf
shambling-mound.actions.3.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, one Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet. Failure: The target is pulled into the shambling mound’s space and has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14). Until the grapple ends, the target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, and it takes 10 (3d6) Lightning damage at the start of each of its turns. When the shambling mound moves, the Grappled target moves with it, costing it no extra movement. The shambling mound can have only one creature Grappled by this action at a time.
shambling-mound.name: Shambling Mound

While the guardian and its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet’s wearer can telepathically call the guardian to travel to it, and the guardian knows the distance and direction to the amulet. If the guardian is within 60 feet of the amulet’s wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (round up) is transferred to the guardian.
shield-guardian.special.2.name: Regeneration
shield-guardian.special.2.desc: The guardian regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point.
shield-guardian.special.3.name: Spell Storing
shield-guardian.special.3.desc: A spellcaster who wears the guardian’s amulet can cause the guardian to store one spell of level 4 or lower. To do so, the wearer must cast the spell on the guardian while within 5 feet of it. The spell has no effect but is stored within the guardian. Any previously stored spell is lost when a new spell is stored. The guardian can cast the spell stored with any parameters set by the original caster, requiring no spell components and using the caster’s spellcasting ability. The stored spell is then lost.
shield-guardian.actions.1.name: Multiattack
shield-guardian.actions.1.desc: The guardian makes two Fist attacks.
shield-guardian.actions.2.name: Fist
shield-guardian.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Force damage.
shield-guardian.reactions.1.name: Protection
shield-guardian.reactions.1.desc: Trigger: An attack roll hits the wearer of the guardian’s amulet while the wearer is within 5 feet of the guardian. Response: The wearer gains a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack and possibly causing it to miss, until the start of the guardian’s next turn.
