solar.actions.1.name: Multiattack
solar.actions.1.desc: The solar makes two Flying Sword attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Slaying Bow.
solar.actions.2.name: Flying Sword
solar.actions.2.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +15, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 22 (4d6 + 8) Slashing damage plus 36 (8d8) Radiant damage. Hit or Miss: The sword magically returns to the solar’s hand or hovers within 5 feet of the solar immediately after a ranged attack.
solar.actions.3.name: Slaying Bow
solar.actions.3.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 21, one creature the solar can see within 600 feet. Failure: If the creature has 100 Hit Points or fewer, it dies. It otherwise takes 24 (4d8 + 6) Piercing damage plus 36 (8d8) Radiant damage.
solar.actions.4.name: Spellcasting
solar.actions.4.desc: The solar casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 25):
solar.bonusActions.1.name: Divine Aid
solar.bonusActions.1.desc: The solar casts Cure Wounds (level 2 version), Lesser Restoration, or Remove Curse, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
solar.legendary.1.name: Blinding Gaze
solar.legendary.1.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 25, one creature the solar can see within 120 feet. Failure: The target has the Blinded condition for 1 minute. Failure or Success: The solar can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.
solar.legendary.2.name: Radiant Teleport
solar.legendary.2.desc: The solar teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 25, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the solar at its destination space. Failure: 11 (2d10) Radiant damage. Success: Half damage.
solar.name: Solar
specter.special.1.name: Incorporeal Movement
specter.special.1.desc: The specter can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
specter.special.2.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
specter.special.2.desc: While in sunlight, the specter has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.
specter.actions.1.name: Life Drain
specter.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, its Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.
specter.name: Specter
specter.languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can’t speak
specter.resistances: acid; bludgeoning; cold; fire; lightning; piercing; slashing; thunder
sphinx-of-wonder.special.1.name: Magic Resistance
sphinx-of-wonder.special.1.desc: The sphinx has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sphinx-of-wonder.actions.1.name: Rend
sphinx-of-wonder.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Radiant damage.
sphinx-of-wonder.reactions.1.name: Burst of Ingenuity
sphinx-of-wonder.reactions.1.desc: Trigger: The sphinx or another creature within 30 feet makes an ability check or a saving throw. Response: The sphinx adds 2 to the roll.
sphinx-of-wonder.name: Sphinx of Wonder
sphinx-of-lore.special.1.name: Inscrutable
sphinx-of-lore.special.1.desc: No magic can observe the sphinx remotely or detect its thoughts without its permission. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain its intentions or sincerity are made with Disadvantage.
sphinx-of-lore.special.2.name: Legendary Resistance
sphinx-of-lore.special.2.desc: If the sphinx fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
sphinx-of-lore.actions.1.name: Multiattack
sphinx-of-lore.actions.1.desc: The sphinx makes three Claw attacks.
sphinx-of-lore.actions.2.name: Claw
sphinx-of-lore.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) Slashing damage.
sphinx-of-lore.actions.3.name: Mind-Rending Roar
sphinx-of-lore.actions.3.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16, each enemy in a 300-foot Emanation originating from the sphinx. Failure: 35 (10d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Incapacitated condition until the start of the sphinx’s next turn.
sphinx-of-lore.actions.4.name: Spellcasting
sphinx-of-lore.actions.4.desc: The sphinx casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):
sphinx-of-lore.legendary.1.name: Arcane Prowl
sphinx-of-lore.legendary.1.desc: The sphinx can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, and it makes one Claw attack.
sphinx-of-lore.legendary.2.name: Weight of Years
sphinx-of-lore.legendary.2.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the sphinx can see within 120 feet. Failure: The target gains 1 Exhaustion level. While the target has any Exhaustion levels, it appears 3d10 years older. Failure or Success: The sphinx can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.
sphinx-of-lore.name: Sphinx of Lore
sphinx-of-valor.special.1.name: Inscrutable
sphinx-of-valor.special.1.desc: No magic can observe the sphinx remotely or detect its thoughts without its permission. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain its intentions or sincerity are made with Disadvantage.
sphinx-of-valor.special.2.name: Legendary Resistance
sphinx-of-valor.special.2.desc: If the sphinx fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
sphinx-of-valor.actions.1.name: Multiattack
sphinx-of-valor.actions.1.desc: The sphinx makes two Claw attacks and uses Roar.
sphinx-of-valor.actions.2.name: Claw
sphinx-of-valor.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 5 ft. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) Slashing damage.
sphinx-of-valor.actions.3.name: Roar
sphinx-of-valor.actions.3.desc: The sphinx emits a magical roar. Whenever it roars, the roar has a different effect, as detailed below (the sequence resets when it takes a Long Rest):
sphinx-of-valor.actions.4.name: First Roar
sphinx-of-valor.actions.4.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 20, each enemy in a 500-foot Emanation originating from the sphinx. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition for 1 minute.
sphinx-of-valor.actions.5.name: Second Roar
sphinx-of-valor.actions.5.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 20, each enemy in a 500-foot Emanation originating from the sphinx. Failure: The target has the Paralyzed condition, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.
sphinx-of-valor.actions.6.name: Third Roar
sphinx-of-valor.actions.6.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20, each enemy in a 500-foot Emanation originating from the sphinx. Failure: 44 (8d10) Thunder damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.
sphinx-of-valor.actions.7.name: Spellcasting
sphinx-of-valor.actions.7.desc: The sphinx casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20):
sphinx-of-valor.legendary.1.name: Arcane Prowl
sphinx-of-valor.legendary.1.desc: The sphinx can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, and it makes one Claw attack.
sphinx-of-valor.legendary.2.name: Weight of Years
sphinx-of-valor.legendary.2.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the sphinx can see within 120 feet. Failure: The target gains 1 Exhaustion level. While the target has any Exhaustion levels, it appears 3d10 years older. Failure or Success: The sphinx can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.
sphinx-of-valor.name: Sphinx of Valor
spirit-naga.special.1.name: Fiendish Restoration
spirit-naga.special.1.desc: If it dies, the naga returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its Hit Points. Only a Wish spell can prevent this trait from functioning.
spirit-naga.actions.1.name: Multiattack
spirit-naga.actions.1.desc: The naga makes three attacks, using Bite or Necrotic Ray in any combination.
spirit-naga.actions.2.name: Bite
spirit-naga.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage.
spirit-naga.actions.3.name: Necrotic Ray
spirit-naga.actions.3.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 60 ft. Hit: 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage.
spirit-naga.actions.4.name: Spellcasting
spirit-naga.actions.4.desc: The naga casts one of the following spells, requiring no Somatic or Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):
spirit-naga.name: Spirit Naga
sprite.actions.1.name: Needle Sword
sprite.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage.
sprite.actions.2.name: Enchanting Bow
sprite.actions.2.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 40/160 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage, and the target has the Charmed condition until the start of the sprite’s next turn.
sprite.actions.3.name: Heart Sight
sprite.actions.3.desc: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 10, one creature within 5 feet the sprite can see (Celestials, Fiends, and Undead automatically fail the save). Failure: The sprite knows the target’s emotions and alignment.
sprite.actions.4.name: Invisibility
sprite.actions.4.desc: The sprite casts Invisibility on itself, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.
sprite.name: Sprite
spy.actions.1.name: Shortsword
spy.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.
spy.actions.2.name: Hand Crossbow
spy.actions.2.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 30/120 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.
spy.bonusActions.1.name: Cunning Action
spy.bonusActions.1.desc: The spy takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.
spy.name: Spy
stirge.actions.1.name: Proboscis
stirge.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage, and the stirge attaches to the target. While attached, the stirge can’t make Proboscis attacks, and the target takes 5 (2d4) Necrotic damage at the start of each of the stirge’s turns. The stirge can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can detach the stirge as an action.
stirge.name: Stirge
stone-giant.actions.1.name: Multiattack
stone-giant.actions.1.desc: The giant makes two attacks, using Stone Club or Boulder in any combination.
stone-giant.actions.2.name: Stone Club
stone-giant.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 15 ft. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.
stone-giant.actions.3.name: Boulder
stone-giant.actions.3.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 60/240 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.
stone-giant.reactions.1.name: Deflect Missile
stone-giant.reactions.1.desc: Trigger: The giant is hit by a ranged attack roll and takes Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage from it. Response: The giant reduces the damage it takes from the attack by 11 (1d10 + 6), and if that damage is reduced to 0, the giant can redirect some of the attack’s force. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature the giant can see within 60 feet. Failure: 11 (1d10 + 6) Force damage.
stone-giant.name: Stone Giant
stone-golem.special.1.name: Immutable Form
stone-golem.special.2.name: Magic Resistance
stone-golem.special.2.desc: The golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
stone-golem.actions.1.name: Multiattack
stone-golem.actions.1.desc: The golem makes two attacks, using Slam or Force Bolt in any combination.
stone-golem.actions.2.name: Slam
stone-golem.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) Force damage.
stone-golem.actions.3.name: Force Bolt
stone-golem.actions.3.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 120 ft. Hit: 22 (4d10) Force damage.
stone-golem.bonusActions.1.name: Slow
stone-golem.bonusActions.1.desc: The golem casts the Slow spell, requiring no spell components and using Constitution as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17).
stone-golem.name: Stone Golem
stone-golem.languages: Understands Common plus two other languages but can’t speak
storm-giant.special.1.name: Amphibious
storm-giant.special.1.desc: The giant can breathe air and water.
storm-giant.actions.1.name: Multiattack
storm-giant.actions.1.desc: The giant makes two attacks, using Storm Sword or Thunderbolt in any combination.
storm-giant.actions.2.name: Storm Sword
storm-giant.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. Hit: 23 (4d6 + 9) Slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) Lightning damage.
storm-giant.actions.3.name: Thunderbolt
storm-giant.actions.3.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +14, range 500 ft. Hit: 22 (2d12 + 9) Lightning damage, and the target has the Blinded and Deafened conditions until the start of the giant’s next turn.
storm-giant.actions.4.name: Lightning Storm
storm-giant.actions.4.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder originating from a point the giant can see within 500 feet. Failure: 55 (10d10) Lightning damage. Success: Half damage.
storm-giant.actions.5.name: Spellcasting
storm-giant.actions.5.desc: The giant casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):
storm-giant.name: Storm Giant
succubus.special.1.name: Incubus Form
succubus.special.1.desc: When the succubus finishes a Long Rest, it can shape-shift into an Incubus, using that stat block instead of this one.
succubus.actions.1.name: Multiattack
succubus.actions.1.desc: The succubus makes one Fiendish Touch attack and uses Charm or Draining Kiss.
succubus.actions.2.name: Fiendish Touch
succubus.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) Psychic damage.
succubus.actions.3.name: Charm
succubus.actions.3.desc: The succubus casts Dominate Person (level 8 version), requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15).
succubus.actions.4.name: Draining Kiss
succubus.actions.4.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature Charmed by the succubus within 5 feet. Failure: 13 (3d8) Psychic damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: The target’s Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.
succubus.bonusActions.1.name: Shape-Shift
succubus.bonusActions.1.desc: The succubus shape-shifts into a Medium or Small Humanoid, or it returns to its true form. Its game statistics are the same in each form, except its Fly Speed is available only in its true form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed.
succubus.name: Succubus
tarrasque.special.1.name: Legendary Resistance
tarrasque.special.1.desc: If the tarrasque fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
tarrasque.special.2.name: Magic Resistance
tarrasque.special.2.desc: The tarrasque has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
tarrasque.special.3.name: Reflective Carapace
tarrasque.special.3.desc: If the tarrasque is targeted by a Magic Missile spell or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, roll 1d6. On a 1–5, the tarrasque is unaffected. On a 6, the tarrasque is unaffected and reflects the spell, turning the caster into the target.
tarrasque.special.4.name: Siege Monster
tarrasque.special.4.desc: The tarrasque deals double damage to objects and structures.
tarrasque.actions.1.name: Multiattack
tarrasque.actions.1.desc: The tarrasque makes one Bite attack and three other attacks, using Claw or Tail in any combination.
tarrasque.actions.2.name: Bite
tarrasque.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +19, reach 15 ft. Hit: 36 (4d12 + 10) Piercing damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 20). Until the grapple ends, the target has the Restrained condition and can’t teleport.
tarrasque.actions.3.name: Claw
tarrasque.actions.3.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +19, reach 15 ft. Hit: 28 (4d8 + 10) Slashing damage.
tarrasque.actions.4.name: Tail
tarrasque.actions.4.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +19, reach 30 ft. Hit: 23 (3d8 + 10) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.
tarrasque.actions.5.name: Thunderous Bellow
tarrasque.actions.5.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 27, each creature and each object that isn’t being worn or carried in a 150-foot Cone. Failure: 78 (12d12) Thunder damage, and the target has the Deafened and Frightened conditions until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage only.
tarrasque.bonusActions.1.name: Swallow
tarrasque.bonusActions.1.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 27, one Large or smaller creature Grappled by the tarrasque (it can have up to six creatures swallowed at a time). Failure: The target is swallowed, and the Grappled condition ends. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions and can’t teleport, it has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the tarrasque, and it takes 56 (16d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the tarrasque’s turns. If the tarrasque takes 60 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the tarrasque must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the tarrasque and has the Prone condition. If the tarrasque dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 20 feet of movement, exiting Prone.
tarrasque.legendary.1.name: Onslaught
tarrasque.legendary.1.desc: The tarrasque moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Claw or Tail attack.
tarrasque.legendary.2.name: World-Shaking Movement
tarrasque.legendary.2.desc: The tarrasque moves up to its Speed. At the end of this movement, the tarrasque creates an instantaneous shock wave in a 60-foot Emanation originating from itself. Creatures in that area lose Concentration and, if Medium or smaller, have the Prone condition. The tarrasque can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.
tarrasque.name: Tarrasque
tough.special.1.name: Pack Tactics
tough.special.1.desc: The tough has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the tough’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.
tough.actions.1.name: Mace
tough.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.
tough.actions.2.name: Heavy Crossbow
tough.actions.2.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +3, range 100/400 ft. Hit: 6 (1d10 + 1) Piercing damage.
tough.name: Tough
tough-boss.special.1.name: Pack Tactics
tough-boss.special.1.desc: The tough has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the tough’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.
tough-boss.actions.1.name: Multiattack
tough-boss.actions.1.desc: The tough makes two attacks, using Warhammer or Heavy Crossbow in any combination.
tough-boss.actions.2.name: Warhammer
tough-boss.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the tough pushes the target up to 10 feet straight away from itself.
tough-boss.actions.3.name: Heavy Crossbow
tough-boss.actions.3.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 100/400 ft. Hit: 13 (2d10 + 2) Piercing damage.
tough-boss.name: Tough Boss
treant.special.1.name: Siege Monster
treant.special.1.desc: The treant deals double damage to objects and structures.
treant.actions.1.name: Multiattack
treant.actions.1.desc: The treant makes two Slam attacks.
treant.actions.2.name: Slam
treant.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.
treant.actions.3.name: Hail of Bark
treant.actions.3.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +10, range 180 ft. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) Piercing damage.
treant.actions.4.name: Animate Trees
treant.actions.4.desc: The treant magically animates up to two trees it can see within 60 feet of itself. Each tree uses the Treant stat block, except it has Intelligence and Charisma scores of 1, it can’t speak, and it lacks this action. The tree takes its turn immediately after the treant on the same Initiative count, and it obeys the treant. A tree remains animate for 1 day or until it dies, the treant dies, or it is more than 120 feet from the treant. The tree then takes root if possible.
treant.name: Treant
troll.special.1.name: Loathsome Limbs
troll.special.1.desc: If the troll ends any turn Bloodied and took 15+ Slashing damage during that turn, one of the troll’s limbs is severed, falls into the troll’s space, and becomes a Troll Limb. The limb acts immediately after the troll’s turn. The troll has 1 Exhaustion level for each missing limb, and it grows replacement limbs the next time it regains Hit Points.
troll.special.2.name: Regeneration
troll.special.2.desc: The troll regains 15 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn’t function on the troll’s next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn’t regenerate.
troll.actions.1.name: Multiattack
troll.actions.1.desc: The troll makes three Rend attacks.
troll.actions.2.name: Rend
troll.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage.
troll.bonusActions.1.name: Charge
troll.bonusActions.1.desc: The troll moves up to half its Speed straight toward an enemy it can see.
troll.name: Troll
troll-limb.special.1.name: Regeneration
troll-limb.special.1.desc: The limb regains 5 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the limb takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn’t function on the limb’s next turn. The limb dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn’t regenerate.
troll-limb.special.2.name: Troll Spawn
troll-limb.special.2.desc: The limb uncannily has the same senses as a whole troll. If the limb isn’t destroyed within 24 hours, roll 1d12. On a 12, the limb turns into a Troll. Otherwise, the limb withers away.
troll-limb.actions.1.name: Rend
troll-limb.actions.1.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) Slashing damage.
troll-limb.name: Troll Limb
unicorn.special.1.name: Legendary Resistance
unicorn.special.1.desc: If the unicorn fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
unicorn.special.2.name: Magic Resistance
unicorn.special.2.desc: The unicorn has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
unicorn.actions.1.name: Multiattack
unicorn.actions.1.desc: The unicorn makes one Hooves attack and one Radiant Horn attack.
unicorn.actions.2.name: Hooves
unicorn.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.
unicorn.actions.3.name: Radiant Horn
unicorn.actions.3.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Radiant damage.
unicorn.actions.4.name: Spellcasting
unicorn.actions.4.desc: The unicorn casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):
unicorn.legendary.1.name: Charging Horn
unicorn.legendary.1.desc: The unicorn moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks, and it makes one Radiant Horn attack.
unicorn.legendary.2.name: Shimmering Shield
unicorn.legendary.2.desc: The unicorn targets itself or one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. The target gains 10 (3d6) Temporary Hit Points, and its AC increases by 2 until the end of the unicorn’s next turn. The unicorn can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.
unicorn.name: Unicorn
vampire-familiar.special.1.name: Vampiric Connection
vampire-familiar.special.1.desc: While the familiar and its vampire master are on the same plane of existence, the vampire can communicate with the familiar telepathically, and the vampire can perceive through the familiar’s senses.
vampire-familiar.actions.1.name: Multiattack
vampire-familiar.actions.1.desc: The familiar makes two Umbral Dagger attacks.
vampire-familiar.actions.2.name: Umbral Dagger
vampire-familiar.actions.2.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (3d4) Necrotic damage. If the target is reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack, the target becomes Stable but has the Poisoned condition for 1 hour. While it has the Poisoned condition, the target has the Paralyzed condition.
vampire-familiar.bonusActions.1.name: Deathless Agility
vampire-familiar.bonusActions.1.desc: The familiar takes the Dash or Disengage action.
vampire-familiar.name: Vampire Familiar
vampire-spawn.special.1.name: Spider Climb
vampire-spawn.special.1.desc: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
vampire-spawn.special.2.name: Vampire Weakness
vampire-spawn.special.3.name: Forbiddance
vampire-spawn.special.3.desc: The vampire can’t enter a residence without an invitation from an occupant.
vampire-spawn.special.4.name: Running Water
vampire-spawn.special.4.desc: The vampire takes 20 Acid damage if it ends its turn in running water.
vampire-spawn.special.5.name: Stake to the Heart
vampire-spawn.special.5.desc: The vampire is destroyed if a weapon that deals Piercing damage is driven into the vampire’s heart while the vampire has the Incapacitated condition.
vampire-spawn.special.6.name: Sunlight
vampire-spawn.special.6.desc: The vampire takes 20 Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
vampire-spawn.actions.1.name: Multiattack
vampire-spawn.actions.1.desc: The vampire makes two Claw attacks and uses Bite.
vampire-spawn.actions.2.name: Claw
vampire-spawn.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13) from one of two claws.
vampire-spawn.actions.3.name: Bite
vampire-spawn.actions.3.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or that has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. Failure: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. The target’s Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains Hit Points equal to that amount.
vampire-spawn.bonusActions.1.name: Deathless Agility
vampire-spawn.bonusActions.1.desc: The vampire takes the Dash or Disengage action.
vampire-spawn.name: Vampire Spawn
vampire-vampire.special.1.name: Legendary Resistance
vampire-vampire.special.1.desc: If the vampire fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
vampire-vampire.special.2.name: Misty Escape
vampire-vampire.special.2.desc: If the vampire drops to 0 Hit Points outside its resting place, the vampire uses Shape-Shift to become mist (no action required). If it can’t use ShapeShift, it is destroyed. While it has 0 Hit Points in mist form, it can’t return to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it returns to its vampire form and has the Paralyzed condition until it regains any Hit Points, and it regains 1 Hit Point after spending 1 hour there.
vampire-vampire.special.3.name: Spider Climb
vampire-vampire.special.3.desc: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
vampire-vampire.special.4.name: Vampire Weakness
vampire-vampire.special.5.name: Forbiddance
vampire-vampire.special.5.desc: The vampire can’t enter a residence without an invitation from an occupant.
vampire-vampire.special.6.name: Running Water
vampire-vampire.special.6.desc: The vampire takes 20 Acid damage if it ends its turn in running water.
vampire-vampire.special.7.name: Stake to the Heart
vampire-vampire.special.7.desc: If a weapon that deals Piercing damage is driven into the vampire’s heart while the vampire has the Incapacitated condition in its resting place, the vampire has the Paralyzed condition until the weapon is removed.
vampire-vampire.special.8.name: Sunlight
vampire-vampire.special.8.desc: The vampire takes 20 Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
vampire-vampire.actions.1.name: Multiattack
vampire-vampire.actions.1.desc: The vampire makes two Grave Strike attacks and uses Bite.
vampire-vampire.actions.2.name: Grave Strike
vampire-vampire.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of two hands.
vampire-vampire.actions.3.name: Bite
vampire-vampire.actions.3.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or that has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. Failure: 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) Necrotic damage. The target’s Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains Hit Points equal to that amount. A Humanoid reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage and then buried rises the following sunset as a Vampire Spawn under the vampire’s control.
vampire-vampire.bonusActions.1.name: Charm
vampire-vampire.bonusActions.1.desc: The vampire casts Charm Person, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17), and the duration is 24 hours. The Charmed target is a willing recipient of the vampire’s Bite, the damage of which doesn’t end the spell. When the spell ends, the target is unaware it was Charmed by the vampire.
vampire-vampire.bonusActions.2.name: Shape-Shift
vampire-vampire.bonusActions.2.desc: If the vampire isn’t in sunlight or running water, it shape-shifts into a Tiny bat (Speed 5 ft., Fly Speed 30 ft.) or a Medium cloud of mist (Speed 5 ft., Fly Speed 20 ft. [hover]), or it returns to its vampire form. Anything it is wearing transforms with it. While in bat form, the vampire can’t speak. Its game statistics, other than its size and Speed, are unchanged. While in mist form, the vampire can’t take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless and can enter an enemy’s space and stop there. If air can pass through a space, the mist can do so, but it can’t pass through liquid. It has Resistance to all damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.
vampire-vampire.legendary.1.name: Beguile
vampire-vampire.legendary.1.desc: The vampire casts Command, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17). The vampire can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.
vampire-vampire.legendary.2.name: Deathless Strike
vampire-vampire.legendary.2.desc: The vampire moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Grave Strike attack.
vampire-vampire.name: Vampire, Vampire Form

vrock.special.1.name: Demonic Restoration
vrock.special.1.desc: If the vrock dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.
vrock.special.2.name: Magic Resistance
vrock.special.2.desc: The vrock has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
vrock.actions.1.name: Multiattack
vrock.actions.1.desc: The vrock makes two Shred attacks.
vrock.actions.2.name: Shred
vrock.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Poison damage.
vrock.actions.3.name: Spores
vrock.actions.3.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the vrock. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. While Poisoned, the target takes 5 (1d10) Poison damage at the start of each of its turns. Emptying a flask of Holy Water on the target ends the effect early.
vrock.actions.4.name: Stunning Screech
vrock.actions.4.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the vrock (demons succeed automatically). Failure: 10 (3d6) Thunder damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the end of the vrock’s next turn.
vrock.name: Vrock
warrior-infantry.special.1.name: Pack Tactics
warrior-infantry.special.1.desc: The warrior has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the warrior’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.
warrior-infantry.actions.1.name: Spear
warrior-infantry.actions.1.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Piercing damage.
warrior-infantry.name: Warrior Infantry
warrior-veteran.actions.1.name: Multiattack
warrior-veteran.actions.1.desc: The warrior makes two Greatsword or Heavy Crossbow attacks.
warrior-veteran.actions.2.name: Greatsword
warrior-veteran.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage.
warrior-veteran.actions.3.name: Heavy Crossbow
warrior-veteran.actions.3.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +3, range 100/400 ft. Hit: 12 (2d10 + 1) Piercing damage.
warrior-veteran.reactions.1.name: Parry
warrior-veteran.reactions.1.desc: Trigger: The warrior is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The warrior adds 2 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.
warrior-veteran.name: Warrior Veteran
water-elemental.special.1.name: Freeze
water-elemental.special.1.desc: If the elemental takes Cold damage, its Speed decreases by 20 feet until the end of its next turn.
water-elemental.special.2.name: Water Form
water-elemental.special.2.desc: The elemental can enter an enemy’s space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.
water-elemental.actions.1.name: Multiattack
water-elemental.actions.1.desc: The elemental makes two Slam attacks.
water-elemental.actions.2.name: Slam
water-elemental.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.
water-elemental.actions.3.name: Whelm
water-elemental.actions.3.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in the elemental’s space. Failure: 22 (4d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14). Until the grapple ends, the target has the Restrained condition, is suffocating unless it can breathe water, and takes 9 (2d8) Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the elemental’s turns. The elemental can grapple one Large creature or up to two Medium or smaller creatures at a time with Whelm. As an action, a creature within 5 feet of the elemental can pull a creature out of it by succeeding on a DC 14 Strength (Athletics) check. Success: Half damage only.
water-elemental.name: Water Elemental
werebear-human.actions.1.name: Multiattack
werebear-human.actions.1.desc: The werebear makes two attacks, using Handaxe or Rend in any combination. It can replace one attack with a Bite attack.
werebear-human.actions.2.name: Handaxe
werebear-human.actions.2.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) Slashing damage.
werebear-human.bonusActions.1.name: Shape-Shift
werebear-human.bonusActions.1.desc: The werebear shape-shifts into a Large bear-humanoid hybrid form or a Large bear, or it returns to its true humanoid form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed.
werebear-human.name: Werebear, Human Form
werebear-hybrid.actions.1.name: Multiattack
werebear-hybrid.actions.1.desc: The werebear makes two attacks, using Handaxe or Rend in any combination. It can replace one attack with a Bite attack.
werebear-hybrid.actions.2.name: Bite
werebear-hybrid.actions.2.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The target is cursed. If the cursed target drops to 0 Hit Points, it instead becomes a Werebear under the GM’s control and has 10 Hit Points. Success: The target is immune to this werebear’s curse for 24 hours.

wererat-human.actions.2.name: Scratch
